scripts.text:
[Vincent]
You're inside Sir Zhed's
looking for new employees,
I don't think you're suited
for this kind of domestic
work, brave adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
您是在澤德大人這裡尋找新僱員的吧？
恕我直言，勇敢的冒險者，
您並不適合這種家內的工作。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
I am Vincert, steward of
this mansion and faithful
servant to its master, Sir
Zhed, the most powerful
man in all of Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
我是文森特，這座宅邸的管家，
也是主人澤德大人的忠實僕人。
他是阿魯納菲茲最有權勢的人。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
My master is currently out
to attend the High Priest
assembly, and has been gone
for a few days. I would like to
ask you for your help with
a problem on his behalf.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
我的主人目前正在外出參加神官集會，
已經離開幾天了。
我想請您幫忙處理一件麻煩事。

scripts.text: I'm too busy.
scripts.translation: 我太忙了。

scripts.text: Sure, why not?
scripts.translation: 當然，為什麼不呢？

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
I understand.
I'm sorry that you're
too busy at the moment...
If you should be available
later, then I'd like to ask for
your assistance once again.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
我明白了。
很抱歉，您現在太忙了……
如果您之後有空，
希望能再次得到您的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
Thank you. You see,
the pope awarded Sir Zhed
for his great contributions to
Arunafeltz with a precious gem.
However, this jewel is missing
and I need your help to find it.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
謝謝您。是這樣的，
教皇為了表彰澤德大人對阿魯納菲茲的巨大貢獻，
贈送了一塊珍貴的寶石。
然而，這塊寶石不見了，
我需要您的幫助找到它。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
I don't have any proof, but
I suspect it was stolen by
Phobe, a servant that
disappeared about the same
time the gem disappeared.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
我沒有任何證據，
但我懷疑是菲比偷走的。
他是一名僕人，
在寶石失竊前後失蹤了。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
Please retrieve this gem
and find who stole it before
Sir Zhed returns and finds
out what happened. If you
can keep this secret, I'd
very much appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
請在澤德大人回來發現真相之前，
找回這塊寶石並查明是誰偷的。
如果您能保守這個秘密，
我將不勝感激。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
I believe that you'd want
to interrogate Phobe, but
he has run away somewhere.
You might want to question the
other servants of his whereabouts. Thanks again for your help.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
我想您大概想審問菲比，
但他已經逃走了。
您可能需要詢問其他僕人他的下落。
再次感謝您的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
I suggest looking around
the mansion and asking the
servants for any clues about
Phobe's current location.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
我建議您在宅邸周圍轉轉，
並向僕人詢問關於菲比現下落的線索。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
We're running out
of time... Please find
the gem and Phobe
as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
時間不多了……
請儘快找到寶石和菲比。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
Ah...!
H-hello! How are
you still, er... That
look on your face? Did
you happen to find Logan?
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
啊……！
您、您好！您還……
您臉上那是什麼表情？
您碰巧找到洛根了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No! I actually got
stabbed by Mogan, and
then we had a talk. What's
the big idea? I come to help
you, and you try to have me
killed! I want an explanation!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不！我其實被莫根刺傷了，
然後我們談了談。你這是什麼意思？
我來幫你，你卻想讓我去死！
我要一個解釋！

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
I... Yes, you deserve
the truth after wh-what
I tried to do to you. First
of all, Phobe is my son, but
please don't tell anybody!
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
我……是的，在我對您做了那樣的事之後，
您有權知道真相。
首先，菲比是我的兒子，
但請不要告訴任何人！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What?
Why, what's
the big deal?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼？
為什麼，這有什麼大不了的？

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
There's something of
a class system here in
Arunafeltz. No one talks
about it, but those that
immigrated here and built this
city are the dominant class.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
阿魯納菲茲這裡存在著某種階級制度。
沒有人談論它，但那些移民到這裡並建立這座城市的
人是統治階級。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
The native people are
second class citizens that
are looked down upon by the
descendents of the settlers
that developed this city. It
is a sad, undeniable truth.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
本地人是二等公民，
受到那些開發這座城市的定居者後代的輕視。
這是一個令人悲哀且不可否認的事實。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
The native people typically
suffer from lower class status,
and usually do the hard, blue
collar work in the city. Jenny,
Phobe's mother, is one of them.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
本地人通常地位較低，
通常從事城市中艱苦的體力勞動。
珍妮，菲比的母親，就是其中之一。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
It's taboo for me to love her,
especially since Sir Zhed has
taken me under his wing and
been like a father to me. If
I married her, it'd greatly
damage his reputation.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
我愛她是禁忌，
尤其是因為澤德大人收留了我，
待我如父親一般。
如果我娶了她，
會嚴重損害他的名聲。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
I tried to control my
feelings but... Well,
Phobe was born. And there's
no going back now. We did
get secretly married though,
and I don't regret that.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
我試圖控制我的感情，但是……
總之，菲比出生了。現在已無法回頭。
不過我們確實秘密結婚了，
我不後悔這一點。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
Phobe must resent me...
I've had to treat him and
his mother like slaves
in front of other people.
I know it's horrible... To be
so cold to those you love.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
菲比一定很怨恨我……
我不得不把我和他母親
在別人面前當作奴隸對待。
我知道這很可怕……
對自己愛的人如此冷漠。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
When he ran off with the
jewel, I was actually more
worried about Phobe than
my master's treasure. So...
I did what I could to try to
get him back: I hired you.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
當他帶著寶石逃跑時，
我其實更擔心菲比，
而不是師父的寶物。所以……
我盡力去把他找回來：
我僱了你。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
However, once you found
Phobe, I planned to have
you killed so that we could
blame you for the theft. I'm
sorry, I know it's wrong, but
I was so worried about my boy!
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
然而，一旦你找到了菲比，
我計劃讓你被殺，
這樣我們就可以把盜竊的罪名推到你身上。
對不起，我知道這不對，
但我太擔心我的孩子了！

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
I hope you forgive me...
I'll do what I should've
done from the beginning...
I'll take full responsibility
for the gem's theft, and Sir
Zhed can do to me what he will.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
希望你能原諒我……
我會做我一開始就該做的事……
我會對寶石的失竊負全責，
澤德大人想對我怎樣都行。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
The gem is very special...
Our pope commanded my
master to keep the jewel
safely, as it has the power
to save Arunafeltz and Rachel
when the time comes.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
這顆寶石非常特別……
教皇命令我的師父妥善保管它，
因為它擁有在關鍵時刻
拯救阿魯納菲茲和拉赫的力量。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The gem is really that
important, huh? Well, you
almost had me killed, but
since I'm still alive, I guess
I can overlook it, you know?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這顆寶石真的那麼重要嗎？
好吧，你差點讓我死了，
但既然我還活著，
我想我可以原諒你，你知道的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You won't get in trouble
if I can find the jewel and
Phobe before Sir Zhed
returns, so I'll try to find
them for you as soon as I can.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果我在澤德大人回來之前
找到寶石和菲比，你就不會惹上麻煩，
所以我會盡快幫你找到他們。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
You're willing to
do that for me? ^333333*Sob*^000000
Even after what I've put
you through? ^333333*Sniff*^000000
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
你願意為我做這些嗎？^333333*抽泣*^000000
在我讓你經歷了這一切之後？^333333*吸鼻子*^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Eh, I went through all
this trouble already, so
I might as well finish the
job. Besides, Phobe is
just a kid, so he's probably
hiding somewhere in town.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃，我已經費了這麼大勁，
不如就把這件事做完吧。
而且，菲比只是個小孩，
他可能正躲在鎮上的某個地方。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
You're willing to
do that for me? ^333333*Sob*^000000

you through? ^333333*Sniff*^000000
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
你願意為我做這些嗎？^333333*抽泣*^000000
在我讓你經歷了這一切之後？^333333*吸鼻子*^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Eh, I went through all
this trouble already, so
I might as well finish the
job. Besides, Phobe is
just a kid, so he's probably
hiding somewhere in town...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃，我已經費了這麼大勁，
不如就把這件事做完吧。
而且，菲比只是個小孩，
他可能正躲在鎮上的某個地方……

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
You came back!
Were you able to
find Phobe?! H-how
is he? Is he alright?
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
你回來了！
你找到菲比了嗎？！他……他怎麼樣了？
他沒事吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh? Oh yeah, he's
just fine. I found Phobe
loitering around Freya's
Spring. Er, he's not willing
to come home yet, but he did
give me the gem he stole.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊？哦對，他沒事。
我在弗蕾雅之泉附近發現菲比在閒逛。
呃，他暫時不想回家，
但他把偷走的寶石還給我了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So... I earned my
reward now, right?
And no one has to die?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那麼……我現在可以拿到我的報酬了吧？
而且不用死人？

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
Yes, yes, thank you so
much! I'll never forget
what you've done for me.
Oh, my boy is alright!
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
是的，是的，非常感謝！
我永遠不會忘記你為我所做的一切。
哦，我的孩子沒事！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
H-hey! Um, take
this jewel! You need
to return it to wherever
it's supposed to go, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿！呃，拿著這顆寶石！
你需要把它送回它該去的地方，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
Oh, yes, I'd better do
that. While I return this
jewel, would you please
tell my wife Jenny that our
boy is okay? She's been
very worried about him, so...
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
哦，是的，我最好這麼做。
在我歸還這顆寶石的時候，
你能幫我告訴我的妻子珍妮，
我們的孩子沒事嗎？
她一直非常擔心他，所以……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You want me to tell
Jenny about Phobe?
Sure, sure, I'll do that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你想讓我告訴珍妮關於菲比的事？
當然，當然，我會去做的。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
Oh! While I return this
jewel, would you please
tell my wife Jenny that our
boy is okay? She's been
very worried about him, so...
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
哦！在我歸還這顆寶石的時候，
你能幫我告訴我的妻子珍妮，
我們的孩子沒事嗎？
她一直非常擔心他，所以……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You want me to tell
Jenny about Phobe?
Sure, sure, I'll do that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你想讓我告訴珍妮關於菲比的事？
當然，當然，我會去做的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I told Jenny that
about Phobe, and that
the gem was returned...
She seemed pretty relieved...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我告訴珍妮關於菲比的事，
以及寶石已經歸還……
她似乎鬆了一口氣……

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
Thank you so much,
adventurer. She's such
a kind, loving woman, and
I hate to see her go through
all that torment. I don't deserve
such a beautiful woman...
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
非常感謝你，冒險者。
她是個善良、充滿愛心的女人，
我不忍心看她經歷那麼多痛苦。
我不配擁有這麼美麗的女人……

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
It's very fortunate that
you've come to save us...
Please drop by the next
time that you're in Rachel,
and I'll try to help you if I can.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
你能來救我們真是太幸運了……
下次你來拉赫的時候，
請順便過來，我會盡力幫你的。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
Ah, actually, I have
one last favor to ask
of you. Would you please
bring this note and package
to my master? He should still
be in the temple right now.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
啊，其實我還有最後一件事想拜託你。
能否請你把這封信和包裹
帶給我的師父？
他現在應該還在神殿裡。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
If you ask for High
Priest Zhed and mention
that I sent you, then he
will meet with you.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
如果你去找大祭司澤德，
並說明是我派你來的，
他就會見你。

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
Now is the time for
me to give you your
reward. How about that?
I don't know what's inside,
but I know these items are
quite valuable nowadays...
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
現在該給你獎勵了。
怎麼樣？
我不知道里面是什麼，
但我知道這些東西現在很值錢……

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
Ah, and this note is a
letter of recommendation
that I have written for you.
Please deliver it to Sir Zhed
as soon as possible. Good bye,
and thank you for everything.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
啊，這封信是我為你寫的推薦信。
請儘快把它交給澤德大人。
再見，感謝你所做的一切。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received a letter
of recommendation
from Vincent.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你收到了
文森特給的推薦信。^000000

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
Thank you for everything
that you've done for me
and my family. If you ever
need help, please don't
hesitate to ask me, alright?
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
謝謝你為我
和我的家人所做的一切。
如果你需要幫助，
請儘管開口，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Logan]
I'm just Logan, one
of the many servants
working here in Sir Zhed's
glorious mansion. I've got
a lot of work to do, so don't
don't distract me, please.
scripts.translation:
[洛根]
我只是洛根，
在澤德大人宏偉的宅邸裡
工作的眾多僕人之一。
我有很多工作要做，
請不要打擾我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, but do
you know man named
Phobe by any chance?
I heard that he used
to work around here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下，請問你認識
一個叫菲比的男子嗎？
我聽說他以前在這裡工作。

scripts.text:
[Logan]
Er, may I ask
you are? Why are
you looking for him?
scripts.translation:
[洛根]
呃，請問你是？
你為什麼在找他？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I've just been
hired to look for him,
and I was told that asking
the servants around here
was a good starting point.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我剛被僱來尋找他，
有人告訴我，
先問問這裡的僕人
是個不錯的開始。

scripts.text:
[Logan]
Oh, okay. Yeah, Phobe's
been missing ever since
he left to buy stuff from
the market a few days ago.
I hope the kid is alright.
scripts.translation:
[洛根]
哦，好的。是的，菲比
自從幾天前去市場買東西后
就失蹤了。
希望那個小孩沒事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Er, kid? Just
how old is Phobe?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃，小孩？
菲比到底多大了？

scripts.text:
[Logan]
He just turned fifteen.
That's all I know about
him. Truth be told, I don't
know much since I just
started working here. Why don't
you ask the senior employees?
scripts.translation:
[洛根]
他剛滿十五歲。
關於他我只知道這些。
說實話，我剛開始在這裡工作，
所以不太瞭解。你為什麼不問問
資深員工呢？

scripts.text:
[Logan]
Let's see...
You could ask Mr. Manson
inside the mansion. He's
been working here for a while.
scripts.translation:
[洛根]
讓我想想……
你可以問問宅邸裡的曼森先生。
他在這裡工作有一段時間了。

scripts.text:
[Logan]
If you want to learn
more about Phobe, you'd
better ask one of the senior
employees since I just started
working here. Mr. Manson in
the mansion is a good bet.
scripts.translation:
[洛根]
如果你想了解更多關於菲比的事，
最好問問資深員工，
因為我剛開始在這裡工作。
宅邸裡的曼森先生是個不錯的選擇。

scripts.text:
[Manson]
I am Manson, one of the
many servants working here
in Sir Zhed's mansion. Er,
would you be more careful
walking around here? I hate
cleaning up after visitors.
scripts.translation:
[曼森]
我是曼森，在澤德大人的宅邸裡
工作的眾多僕人之一。呃，
你能不能走路小心點？
我不喜歡清理訪客留下的痕跡。

scripts.text:
[Manson]
You know, considering
that natives like me are
looked down upon and
are kinda of lower class,
I'm really lucky to work for
Sir Zhed here in the mansion.
scripts.translation:
[曼森]
你知道嗎，考慮到像我這樣的原住民
被看不起，
地位也比較低，
我能在澤德大人的宅邸裡工作
真的很幸運。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, but do you
know a man named Phobe?
He's gone missing, so I've
been hired to look for him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下，請問你認識
一個叫菲比的男子嗎？
他失蹤了，所以我被僱來尋找他。

scripts.text:
[Manson]
Ah, so you're the one
that Vincent hired, huh?
That's good, that's good.
I'm pretty sure Phobe is
hiding somewhere and
just goofing around.
scripts.translation:
[曼森]
啊，原來你是文森特僱來的啊？
那就好，那就好。
我相當確定菲比只是躲在某個地方
玩而已。

scripts.text:
[Manson]
I'm sure he can take care
of himself, so we won't have
to worry too much. Let's see,
he asked me if I had any
errands to for him to do,
so I sent him to the market.
scripts.translation:
[曼森]
我相信他能照顧好自己，
所以我們不用太擔心。
讓我想想，
他問我有沒有什麼差事讓他去辦，
所以我派他去市場了。

scripts.text:
[Manson]
That's the last time I saw
him. I guess he's using the
money I gave him to feed himself
while he's run away. He's young,
so I can't really blame him.
We've all done crazy things~
scripts.translation:
[曼森]
那是最後一次見到他。
我想他大概是用我給他的錢
在逃跑期間填飽肚子吧。
他還年輕，所以我不能怪他。
我們誰沒做過瘋狂的事呢~

scripts.text:
[Manson]
Ah, our gardener Jenny
was the one that introduced
me to him. She's worked for
Sir Zhed for a long time, and
she loves kids. I guess she's
got a soft spot for Phobe.
scripts.translation:
[曼森]
啊，是我們的園丁珍妮
把我介紹給他的。
她在澤德大人這裡工作很久了，
而且她很喜歡孩子。
我想她對菲比特別關照。

scripts.text:
[Manson]
No one knows who his
parents are, so I guess
he's an orphan. That's
probably why she has him.
working with us in the mansion.
scripts.translation:
[曼森]
沒人知道他的父母是誰，
所以他大概是個孤兒。
也許這就是為什麼她讓他
在府邸裡為我們工作。

scripts.text:
[Manson]
Jenny has done a lot for
that boy. We skipped our
usual employment process
just for her, you know? And
now Jenny and even Vincent
are worried about him missing.
scripts.translation:
[曼森]
珍妮為那個男孩做了很多。
你知道的，我們甚至
為了她跳過了常規的僱傭流程。
現在珍妮甚至文森特
都擔心他失蹤了。

scripts.text:
[Manson]
You know, if you want to
know more about that kid,
you should talk to Jenny.
She's working in the garden
now, and she'd appreciate
your help in finding Phobe.
scripts.translation:
[曼森]
你知道嗎，如果你想了解更多
關於那個孩子的事，
你應該去和珍妮談談。
她現在正在花園裡工作，
她會感激你幫忙尋找菲比的。

scripts.text:

know more about that kid,
you should talk to Jenny.
She's working in the garden
now, and she'd appreciate
your help in finding Phobe.
scripts.translation:

她會感激你幫忙尋找菲比的。

scripts.text:
[Manson]
Nuts, there's so much
work to do! I never seem
to get it all done until
the very end of the day.
Ah well, it's a living.
scripts.translation:
[曼森]
天哪，有這麼多工作要做！
我似乎總是在一天結束前
無法完成所有事情。
唉，混口飯吃嘛。

scripts.text:
[Jenny]
These grounds are owned by
Sir Zhed and are considered
private property. Please
leave immediately if you
haven't been invited!
scripts.translation:
[珍妮]
這片土地屬於澤德大人，
被視為私人財產。
如果您沒有受到邀請，
請立即離開！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, but are
you Jenny? I've been
told by Manson to speak
to you if I wanted to learn
more about Phobe. You see,
Vincent hired me to find him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下，請問您是
珍妮嗎？曼森告訴我，
如果我想了解更多關於菲比的事，
應該和您談談。您看，
文森特僱我來尋找他。

scripts.text:
[Jenny]
Oh! That's wonderful
news! Y-yes, I'm Jenny.
What did you need to know?
scripts.translation:
[珍妮]
哦！真是個好訊息！
是...是的，我是珍妮。
您想知道什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Er, anything you could
tell me would be fine.
Things like his favorite
hangouts might also be
helpful for me to investigate.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃，您能告訴我的
任何資訊都可以。
比如他常去的地方
也可能有助於我的調查。

scripts.text:
[Jenny]
Phobe is such a good
boy. I don't know what
kind of trouble he's gotten
into this time, but he's
really a great kid if you
just give him a chance.
scripts.translation:
[珍妮]
菲比是個好孩子。
我不知道他這次又惹了什麼麻煩，
但如果你給他機會，
他真的是個很棒的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Jenny]
Oh... Vincent must
also be--I'm-I'm very
glad that he's hired
you. But as for places
he might be found, I'm
not sure if I know.
scripts.translation:
[珍妮]
哦...文森特肯定也--我-我很高興
他僱了你。但至於他可能在
哪裡，我不確定我知道。

scripts.text:
[Jenny]
Have you tried the
market? That's where
he was last seen, wasn't it?
Maybe they have some idea
of where he was going?
scripts.translation:
[珍妮]
你試過市場嗎？
那是他最後被看到的地方，不是嗎？
也許他們知道他去哪裡了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh... That's a good idea.
Alright, I guess I can go
to the market and ask around.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦...這是個好主意。
好吧，我想我可以去市場
問問周圍的情況。

scripts.text:
[Jenny]
Please find Phobe,
and bring him back
safely as soon as you
can! I can't help but worry
about that boy, you know?
scripts.translation:
[珍妮]
請找到菲比，
並儘快安全地帶他回來！
我忍不住擔心那個男孩，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll do my best
First, I guess I should ask
around the market where
Phobe was last seen.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我會盡力的。
首先，我想我應該去市場
問問菲比最後出現的地方。

can! I can't help but worry

scripts.translation:

請找到菲比，

我忍不住擔心那個男孩，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jenny]
Oh! You're back!
Did you find Phobe?
scripts.translation:
[珍妮]
哦！你回來了！
你找到菲比了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually... Uh...
I have something very
important to discuss
with Vincent first.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其實...呃...
我有一些非常重要的事
要先和文森特討論。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually... Uh...
Not just yet. But I'm
following a really good
lead! Don't worry, I'll
find him soon, I promise.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其實...呃...
還沒找到。但我正在追蹤
一條很好的線索！別擔心，
我會很快找到他的，我保證。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually... Uh...
I should report to
Vincent first and return
this jewel, but I'll deliver
some good news soon,
I promise. Se eyou later~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其實...呃...
我應該先向文森特彙報
並歸還這顆寶石，但我很快就會
帶來好訊息，我保證。再見~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, he's fine, just
hanging around the south
side of town. He's safe,
but he's not willing to
come home just right now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，他沒事，
只是在鎮子南邊閒逛。
他很安全，
但暫時不願意回家。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The jewel's been returned,
so everything should be fine
now. Also, Vincent explained
everything to me. You know,
how you, him, and Phobe
are all related, so...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
寶石已經歸還了，
現在應該一切都好了。
另外，文森特
把一切都告訴我了。
你知道，
你、他和菲比
都有血緣關係，所以...

scripts.text:
[Jenny]
Oh! Oh, I see. He told
you our secret? Well,
I guess we can trust you.
Mostly, I'm just relieved
that my son is alright, and
that he won't get in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[珍妮]
哦！哦，我明白了。
他告訴了你我們的秘密？
好吧，我想我們可以信任你。
我主要是鬆了一口氣，
我的兒子沒事，
而且他不會惹上麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Jenny]
Anyway, even though Phobe
is being pretty stubborn,
I'm sure he'll come back
soon. As he grows up, I think
he'll understand his father's
position a little bit better.
scripts.translation:
[珍妮]
總之，雖然菲比
現在很固執，
但我相信他很快就會回來的。
隨著他長大，
我想他會更理解
他父親處境的。

scripts.text:
[Jenny]
I hope so. Although
it's been very hard for
all three of us to live
this way, I couldn't be
happier. Thank you for
all of your help, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[珍妮]
希望如此。雖然
我們三個人這樣生活
非常艱難，
但我再開心不過了。
謝謝你所有的幫助，
冒險者~

scripts.text:
[Jenny]
Thank you so much for
finding my son. If there's
anything I can ever do for
you, please let me know.
You don't know how grateful
I am to you as a mother...
scripts.translation:
[珍妮]
非常感謝你
找到了我的兒子。
如果有什麼我能幫你的，
請告訴我。
你不知道我作為母親
有多感激你...

scripts.text:
[Idle Merchant]
Man! Business is going
sooo slooow right now!
Well, no point standing
around this dump much
longer. Maybe I should
pack it up and go home.
scripts.translation:
[閒散的商人]
天哪！生意
現在慢得不得了！
好吧，在這個鬼地方
站久了也沒意義。
也許我該收拾東西
回家了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me?
Hello? Sir?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下？
你好？先生？

scripts.text:
[Idle Merchant]
Finally! A customer!
I knew someone would come
eventually! So whaddya want
to buy? I got all sorts of
handy little knickknacks~
scripts.translation:
[閒散的商人]
終於！有顧客了！
我就知道遲早會有人來的！
那麼你想買點什麼？
我這兒有各種各樣
實用的小玩意兒~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sorry, not interested.
I just wanted to ask if
you've seen a boy around
here that's about fifteen
years old. He supposedly
ran away from home, so.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，不感興趣。
我只是想問問
你最近有沒有見過
一個大約十五歲的男孩。
聽說他離家出走了。

scripts.text:
[Idle Merchant]
Fifteen? My own son is
that age... I'm sorry, but
I haven't seen any lads that
age around here in the past
few days. Though, you might
want to ask the other merchants.
scripts.translation:
[閒散的商人]
十五歲？我兒子
也是那個年紀...抱歉，
這幾天我沒在這裡
見過那個年紀的男孩。
不過，
你可以問問其他商人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Cool. Thanks a lot.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的。非常感謝。

scripts.text:
[Idle Merchant]
Alright, then!
Good luck bringing that
boy home! Oh, and are you
sure that you don't want
to take a look around?
scripts.translation:
[閒散的商人]
好的！
祝你順利把那個男孩
帶回家！哦，還有，
你確定不想
看看我的貨嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Er, what exactly do
you sell here? I can't
recognize any of these
goods that you're selling.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃，你這裡
具體賣什麼？
我認不出
你賣的這些商品。

scripts.text:
[Idle Merchant]
You know how some restaurants
offer dishes with mock meat
made out of vegetables and
stuff like wheat gluten, right?
scripts.translation:
[閒散的商人]
你知道有些餐廳
提供用蔬菜
和麵筋之類的
做的仿肉菜嗎？

scripts.text:
[Idle Merchant]
Get this: mock vegetables
made out of pure meat! Now
how's that for the best of both
worlds? Yeah? Yeah? Here,
why don't you try a sample?
scripts.translation:
[閒散的商人]
聽好了：
用純肉做的仿蔬菜！
這難道不是
兩全其美嗎？對吧？對吧？
來，
嚐嚐樣品吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What the?!
No way in hell am
I putting that in my
mouth! What the heck
is that supposed to be?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼？！
我絕對不可能
把那個放進嘴裡！
那到底是什麼鬼東西？

scripts.text:
[Idle Merchant]
It's the world's
first zucchini...
Made completely out
of Grade A Sirloin Steak!
scripts.translation:
[閒散的商人]
這是世界上
第一個西葫蘆...
完全由
特級西冷牛排製成！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No no no! I've got to
go and ask those other
merchants about that
missing boy. Er, but
good luck selling that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不不不！我得
去問問其他商人
那個失蹤的男孩。
呃，不過
祝你生意興隆。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(^333333I better ask the other
merchants around here if
they've seen that boy. I'm
wasting my time talking to
this crazy merchant and his
ridiculous mock vegetables.^000000)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(^333333我最好問問
這裡其他商人
有沒有見過那個男孩。
我和這個瘋狂的商人
以及他那些荒謬的仿蔬菜
浪費時間了。^000000)

scripts.text:
[Idle Merchant]
I'm thinking of quitting
this business... No one
to seems to want whatever
I'm selling! I definitely can't
make a living like this.
scripts.translation:
[閒散的商人]
我在考慮放棄這門生意了...
似乎沒有人想要我賣的東西！
這樣下去我肯定沒法維持生計。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me,
um... Hello?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下，
呃...你好？

scripts.text:
[Idle Merchant]
Oh! Welcome to my shop!
How can I help you today?
scripts.translation:
[閒散的商人]
哦！歡迎光臨我的店鋪！
今天有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, I'm not
here to buy anything...
I'm looking for a boy
named Phobe that was
here a few days ago.
Have you seen him?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其實，我不是來買東西的...
我在找一個叫菲比的男孩，
他幾天前來過這裡。
您見過他嗎？

scripts.text:
[Idle Merchant]
Oh! Yeah, last night,
some guy asked me to tell
anyone looking for this guy
named Phobe to give you
a message. Basically, he wants
you to come to the ''ice cave.''
scripts.translation:
[閒散的商人]
哦！是的，昨晚，
有個男人讓我告訴任何尋找
這個叫菲比的男孩的人，
給他帶個口信。基本上，
他想讓你去“冰洞”。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Who asked you to tell
me that? How did he know
that I'd come over here?
Does he know where Phobe
is? I-Is Phobe alright?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
誰讓你告訴我這個的？
他怎麼知道我會來這裡？
他知道菲比在哪裡嗎？
菲...菲比沒事吧？

scripts.text:
[Idle Merchant]
No clue. I told you all
I know. Let's see, his
name was... Nogan?
Rogan? Something
like that. That's
all I know, honest.
scripts.translation:
[閒散的商人]
完全不知道。我已經把我知道的
都告訴你了。讓我想想，
他的名字是...莫根？
羅根？大概是那樣。
我只知道這些，真的。

scripts.text:
[Idle Merchant]
So the kid's missing,
huh? Good luck finding
him. Oh, and be careful
in that ice cave. That place
can be plenty dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[閒散的商人]
所以那個小孩失蹤了，
是嗎？祝你找到他。哦，
還有，在那冰洞裡要小心。
那個地方可能非常危險。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Th-there's not enough
air here, it's so stuffy!
Hey, get away! You're
wasting all of my
precious oxygen!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
這...這裡空氣不夠，
太悶了！
嘿，走開！你浪費了我
寶貴的氧氣！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, but do you
know a man named
Rogan? I'm here to--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下，你知道
一個叫羅根的男人嗎？
我來這裡是為了--

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Hah! I had no idea
it'd be this simple!
Easiest money I've
ever made! Bwahahaha!
Time for you to die, kid!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
哈！我沒想到
會這麼簡單！
這是我賺過最容易的錢！
哇哈哈哈！
該死的時候了，小鬼！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Hyah!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
嘿呀！

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis suspicious man
wounded you with a throwing
dagger, and then threw another
one that you managed to dodge.
You quickly retaliate to keep
him from further harming you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這個可疑的男子
用投擲短劍傷了你，
然後又扔了一把你成功躲開了。
你迅速反擊，
以防止他進一步傷害你。^000000

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Argh! I...
I guess I underestimated
you! You're a lot stronger
than when you're taken by
surprise, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
啊！我...
我低估你了！
你比被偷襲時強多了，
冒險者！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, who the hell are
you?! Are you Rogan?
Are you the one that
kidnapped Phobe?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，你他媽的是誰？！
你是羅根嗎？
是你綁架了菲比嗎？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
What th--? I didn't
kidnap nobody! I don't
know any Phobe! I was
just hired to kill you and
bring your body to my client.
This wasn't what I expected.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
什...什麼？我沒有
綁架任何人！我不認識
什麼菲比！我只是受僱
來殺你並把你的屍體
交給我的僱主。
這不是我預期的。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Vincent's instructions
were to kill anyone that
asked about Rogan, some
name he made up. My name
is Mogan. Gosh... I thought
you were a really bad guy.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
文森特的指示是
殺死任何詢問羅根的人，
那是他編造的名字。
我的名字是莫根。天哪...
我以為你是個很壞的人。

scripts.text:
[Mogan]
Hey, set me straight
here. Did you steal
something really
valuable, like some
red jewel or something?
scripts.translation:
[莫根]
嘿，給我解釋清楚。
你偷了什麼非常值錢的東西，
比如大紅寶石之類的嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh? No! Vincent actually
sent me to look for the guy
that stole that jewel, and
to retrieve it for him!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼？不！文森特
實際上是派我來找
偷了那顆寶石的人，
併為他取回它！

scripts.text:
[Mogan]
It looks like he set
us up, dude. That's...
That's really low. Sorry,
if I had known, I wouldn't
have done it. Why would
he manipulate us like that?
scripts.translation:
[莫根]
看來是他設局害了我們，老兄。這...這太卑鄙了。抱歉，如果我知道的話，我就不會這麼做了。他為什麼要那樣利用我們？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know...
I'm going to talk
to Vincent and make
him explain everything.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不知道...
我要去找文森特，讓他把一切都解釋清楚。

us up, dude. That's...
That's really low. Sorry,
if I had known, I wouldn't
have done it. Why would

scripts.translation:
[莫根]
看來是他設局害了我們，老兄。這...這太卑鄙了。抱歉，如果我知道的話，我就不會這麼做了。他為什麼要那樣利用我們？

scripts.text:

I'm going to talk
to Vincent and make
him explain everything.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不知道...
我要去找文森特，讓他把一切都解釋清楚。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
別管我！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou catch a shining
glint from this boy's
back pocket. Perhaps he
has the jewel that Vincent
wants you to retrieve.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你從這個男孩的後口袋裡看到一道閃光。也許他正藏著文森特讓你取回的那顆寶石。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, you.
You must be
Phobe, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，你。
你一定是菲比，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Yeah?
So what?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
是又怎樣？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Your father sent
me here to find you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你父親派我
來這裡找你。

scripts.text:
[Phobe]
No! Don't touch me!
I have no father!
H-he's dead to me!
scripts.translation:
[菲比]
不！別碰我！
我沒有父親！
他...他對我來說已經死了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, in any case, I need
to return the jewel that
you're hiding in your pocket.
I know that it really belongs
to Sir Zhed.  If I don't, then
your father will be in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
總之，我需要
取回你藏在口袋裡的寶石。
我知道它其實屬於澤德爵士。
如果我不取回它，
你父親就會有麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Phobe]
Hah! You mean ''Mister
Vincent!'' That's fine
by me! That's exactly
why I took this thing!
scripts.translation:
[菲比]
哈！你是說“文森特先生”吧！
那正好！
這就是我拿走它的理由！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, yeah? How do you
think Ms. Jenny will
feel? Do you think
that she'll be happy
hearing about this?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，是嗎？你覺得
珍妮小姐會怎麼想？
你覺得她聽到這件事
會高興嗎？

scripts.text:
[Phobe]
..............................
...So you know about
our family secret, huh?
Alright, I'll give this to
you. But I'm doing this for
my mom, and not for him!
scripts.translation:
[菲比]
..............................
...原來你知道
我們家的秘密，是嗎？
好吧，我把它給你。
但我這麼做是為了我媽媽，
不是為了他！

scripts.text:
^3355FFPhobe gingerly pulls
the shining red jewel
from his pocket and
reluctantly hands it to you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF菲比小心翼翼地從口袋裡
掏出那顆閃閃發光的大紅寶石，
不情願地遞給了你。^000000

scripts.text:
[Phobe]
Just so you know,
I don't plan on going
back home! Well, just
not this second anyway.
But let my mom know that
I'm fine and not to worry.
scripts.translation:
[菲比]
告訴你一聲，
我暫時不打算回家！
至少現在不回去。
但請告訴我媽媽我很好，
讓她別擔心。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright, I'll tell your mom
But you should be getting
back to them soon. Your
father took a really big
risk covering up for you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，我會告訴你媽媽。
但你最好快點回去。
你父親為了替你掩蓋這件事，
冒了很大的風險。

scripts.text:
[Phobe]
Hmpf! I...
I don't care!
scripts.translation:
[菲比]
哼！我...
我才不在乎！

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt doesn't look like
you can force Phobe to
return home for now, so
you should bring this red
jewel back to Vincent.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF看來現在你無法強迫菲比回家，
所以你應該把這顆大紅寶石
帶回給文森特。^000000

scripts.text:
[Phobe]
I... I'm not ready
to go back home just
fine, and let Mister Vincent
know that I'm not sorry
for what I did, okay?!
scripts.translation:
[菲比]
我...我還沒準備好
回家。還有，告訴文森特先生，
我對我所做的事一點也不後悔，
聽到了嗎？！

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt doesn't look like
you can force Phobe to
return home for now, so
you should bring this red
jewel back to Vincent.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF看來現在你無法強迫菲比回家，
所以你應該把這顆大紅寶石
帶回給文森特。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know, you should
quit making trouble and
listen to your parents.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道嗎，你應該
少惹點麻煩，
聽你父母的話。

scripts.text:
[Phobe]
You're not the boss
of me! Mind your own
business! Jeez louise!
scripts.translation:
[菲比]
你管不了我！
管好你自己吧！
真是的！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't mind my own
business if your actions
are causing this much trouble
to so many other people! You
need to act more responsibly!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果你的行為
給這麼多人
帶來這麼多麻煩，
我怎麼可能
不管閒事！
你得對自己
的行為負責！

scripts.text:
[Phobe]
Mmmrrrr...
Gosh... Fine.
scripts.translation:
[菲比]
嗚...
真是的...
好吧。

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
If I had only turned
myself in... Maybe if I had
made an effort to pay for
my crime, me and Bruspetti
could have had a chance...
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
如果當時
我自首了...
也許如果我
努力償還
我的罪孽，
我和布魯斯佩蒂
還有機會...

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
Please... Please just
leave me alone. I've lost
the woman I love because
of something stupid I did
in the past. If you want to
turn me in, go ahead...
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
求求你...
請別管我了。
因為我過去
做的一件蠢事，
我失去了
我愛的女人。
如果你想
把我交出去，
那就去吧...

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
I suppose it's my
fate to bear this guilt.
It's already destroyed my
best chance of ever being
truly happy. Bruspetti...
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
我想，揹負
這份罪孽
是我的命運。
它已經毀掉了
我獲得真正
幸福的機會。
布魯斯佩蒂...

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
I suppose there's
no reason to hide
anything anymore...
You've probably figured
the important stuff by now...
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
我想，現在
沒什麼好隱瞞
的了...
你大概已經
猜到了
重要的事...

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
I used to work as one
of the security guards in
Lighthalzen. We basically
watched the border between
the rich area and the slums.
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
我以前是
裡希塔樂鎮
的保安之一。
我們基本上
負責看守
富人區和貧民窟
之間的邊界。

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
I actually was ordered
to kill someone that was
repeatedly moving between
the slums and the rich area.
He was a wealthy kid...
Didn't really deserve it.
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
我實際上
接到命令，
要殺一個
在貧民窟和
富人區之間
頻繁出入的人。
他是個富家子弟...
其實並不該死。

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
I was paid a lot of money
to do it. At first, I thought
I was just doing my job. You
know, I mean, the law was on
my side. But the boy's blood
wouldn't wash off my hands...
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
我收了
很多錢
才做的。
起初，我以為
自己只是在
履行職務。
你知道，
法律站在我
這一邊。但那個
男孩的血
怎麼也洗不掉...

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
I was scared to kill him,
but once I did it, the guilt
and the torment has been
unbearable! I haven't been
able to sleep... That's why
I had to leave Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
我害怕
殺他，但
一旦做了，
那種愧疚
和折磨就
難以忍受！
我再也
睡不著了...
所以我不得不
離開裡希塔樂鎮。

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
Bruspetti shocked me when
she had learned about what
I did back then. My one true
love... She couldn't bear the
truth. When she heard it from
my own lips, she went mad...
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
布魯斯佩蒂
得知我當年
做的事後
非常震驚。
我唯一的
真愛...
她無法接受
真相。當她
從我嘴裡
聽到時，
她瘋了...

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
I couldn't stop her...
I struggled, and tried to
save her, but she managed
to drown herself in Freya's
Spring. She's gone from my
life. Just like that. Forever.
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
我攔不住她...
我掙扎著，
試圖救她，
但她還是
在芙蕾雅之泉
淹死了。
她從我
的生活中
消失了。
就這樣。
永遠地。

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
I came here after
killing a man to start
a new life, maybe get
a clean slate, but I end up
indirectly killing the woman
I love. Why God?! Why?!
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
我殺了一個人
後來到這裡，
想開始
新生活，
也許能
重新開始，
結果卻間接
害死了
我愛的女人。
為什麼，神啊？！
為什麼？！

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
Are you happy now?
Are you happy now that?
I've told you the truth?
Doesn't that make me and
you feel so much better?!
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
你現在
開心了嗎？
我告訴你
真相，你
開心了嗎？
這難道不會
讓你和我
都感覺
好受一點嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
...............................
God! My life sucks!

[Katinshuell]
^333333*Pant pant*^000000
After all this
time... I thought
I could run away...
But the voices still
h-haunt me... Ha ha ha...
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
^333333*喘氣*^000000
過了這麼久...
我以為
我可以
逃掉...
但那些聲音
還在
折磨我... 哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
I...
I don't deserve this!
Why do you keep hounding
me with these questions?
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
我...
我不該
受這些！
你為什麼
一直用這些
問題
糾纏我？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Did... Did something
happen when Bruspetti
confronted you at Freya's
Spring? What did exactly
did she learn about
you in Lighthalzen?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
當布魯斯佩蒂
在芙蕾雅之泉
質問你時，
發生了什麼？
她在裡希塔樂鎮
到底
知道了
關於你的
什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
I... I don't have
to tell you anything!
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
我...我不用
告訴你
任何事！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How can you say that?!
I just read in Bruspetti's
diary that she learned
something horrible about
you, and it involved a
Knife... just like this one.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你怎麼能
這麼說？！
我剛在
布魯斯佩蒂的
日記裡讀到，
她得知了
關於你的
可怕事情，
而且涉及
一把刀...
就像
這把一樣。

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
.........!
.............
NOoo! I'm sorry, it's
my fault! I was desperate!
You don't understand how
I used to live, you d-don't--!
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
.........!
.............
不...不！對不起，是我的錯！我當時太絕望了！
你...你不懂我以前是怎麼活的，你...你不懂——！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh...?
Mr. Katinshuell?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...？
卡廷舒爾先生？

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
I...
I don't deserve this!
Why do you keep hounding
me with these questions?
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
我...
我不該
受這些！
你為什麼
一直用這些
問題
糾纏我？

scripts.text:
[{0}]

scripts.translation:
[{0}]
當布魯斯佩蒂
在芙蕾雅之泉
質問你時，
發生了什麼？
她在裡希塔樂鎮
到底
知道了
關於你的
什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
I... I don't have
to tell you anything!
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
我...我不用
告訴你
任何事！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(^333333He's still resisting
me... How can I get
him to reveal the truth?^000000)

[{0}]
Let's see...
Oh this entry looks
interesting. It's all
about you, Katinshuell.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
讓我看看...
哦，這一條看起來很有趣。
全都在寫你，卡廷舒爾。

scripts.text:
- Date: OOXX -
I'm so in love with him,
but he always changes the
subject whenever I ask him
personal questions about his
past. Could it be that he's
hiding something from me?
scripts.translation:
- 日期：OOXX -
我這麼愛他，
但每次我問起他過去的私事，
他總是轉移話題。
難道他在對我隱瞞什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
- Date: OOXX -
Is it another woman?
I can't help but feel
jealous! I need to know.
That's why I've decided to
go to Lighthalzen and see
what I can find out.
scripts.translation:
- 日期：OOXX -
是別的女人嗎？
我忍不住感到嫉妒！我必須知道。
所以我決定去裡希塔樂鎮，
看看能查出什麼。

scripts.text:
- Date: OOXO -
Dear Diary,
Today I just learned
the horrible truth... I need
to make him confess it to
me. I hope we can still be
together after all of this...
scripts.translation:
- 日期：OOXO -
親愛的日記，
今天我得知了可怕的真相...
我必須讓他向我坦白。
希望經歷這一切後，
我們還能在一起...

scripts.text:
- Date: OOXO -
But I don't know if
I can live with this!
The man I love... It's
unthinkable that he'd
use a Knife t-to... I just
want to throw up.
scripts.translation:
- 日期：OOXO -
但我不知道我能否忍受這一切！
我深愛的男人...他居然用那把刀去...簡直不可思議。
我簡直想吐。

scripts.text:
- Date: OOXO -
I'm planning to meet him
tomorrow at Freya's Spring.
I can't help but look at him
differently now, but still...
He's the man I truly love.
scripts.translation:
- 日期：OOXO -
我計劃明天在芙蕾雅之泉見他。
我現在看他的眼神都不一樣了，但即便如此...
他依然是我真正深愛的男人。

scripts.text:
- Date: OOXO -
I hope that I have
good news the next
time I write in this diary...
Well, here's hoping.
scripts.translation:
- 日期：OOXO -
希望下次寫日記時，
我能有一些好訊息...
好吧，但願如此。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, that was
the very last page...
What happened when
Bruspetti confronted
you at Freya's Spring?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，這就是最後一頁了...
布魯斯佩蒂在芙蕾雅之泉質問你時，
發生了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
Damn it! I don't want to
think about her anymore!
Get away from me, and take
Bruspetti's diary with you!
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
該死！我不想再想起她了！
離我遠點，把布魯斯佩蒂的日記本帶走！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What?! No way, not after
that little outburst about
killing or not killing Bruspetti!
Fine, if you're not going to
talk, then I'm going to flip
through this diary for answers.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼？！
在你剛才那番關於殺或不殺布魯斯佩蒂的爆發之後，
怎麼可能！
好吧，如果你不肯說，那我就翻翻這本日記找答案。

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
Ha ha ha...
Is this some sort
of interrogation?
I-I've done nothing
wrong! Go ahead,
ask me anything!
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
哈哈...
這是在審訊我嗎？
我...我什麼都沒做錯！
儘管問吧，問什麼都行！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright then, why
don't you explain this?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那好吧，你解釋一下這個？

scripts.text: Mr. Shendar's House
scripts.translation: 申達爾先生的家

scripts.text: Lighthalzen
scripts.translation: 裡希塔樂鎮

scripts.text: Freya's Spring
scripts.translation: 芙蕾雅之泉

scripts.text: Bruspetti
scripts.translation: 布魯斯佩蒂

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Mr. Shendar, Bruspetti's
father, says that someone
has been sneaking into his
house for some reason.
Now, why would you do that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
布魯斯佩蒂的父親，申達爾先生，
說有人因為某種原因潛入他的家。
那你為什麼要這麼做？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You recognized
Bruspetti's diary
pretty quickly...
And you did mention
you were looking for it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你認出藍色的日記本
好快啊...
而且你剛才還說
你在找它。

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
Hmpf! S-stop
talking crazy talk!
I don't know what
you're talking about!
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
哼！別...別胡說八道！
我不知道你在說什麼！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know, I found out
that Bruspetti was planning
on going to Lighthalzen.
It seems that she needed
to learn something really
important over there...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道嗎，我查到了
布魯斯佩蒂打算去裡希塔樂鎮。
看來她在那裡
需要學習一些非常重要的東西...

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
No...!
She couldn't have...!
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
不...！
她不可能...！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright. It's no use
pretending that you don't
know her. You were her
boyfriend, weren't you?
What would she be trying
to find in Lighthalzen?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧。裝不認識她
是沒用的。你是她
的男朋友，對吧？
她想在裡希塔樂鎮
找什麼？

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
No! No no no!
Shut up! Shut up!
Please! Just leave
me alone! Get away
from me right now!
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
不！不不不！
閉嘴！閉嘴！
求你了！別纏著我！
現在立刻離我遠點！

scripts.text: Mr. Shendar's House
scripts.translation: 申達爾先生的家

scripts.text: Freya's Spring
scripts.translation: 芙蕾雅之泉

scripts.text: Recent Break-up
scripts.translation: 最近分手

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So while she was away
in Lighthalzen, you snuck
in Mr. Shendar's house and--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以趁她去裡希塔樂鎮
的時候，你溜進了
申達爾先生的家，然後——

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
Y-yes! Yes, that's right!
It's because I was so worried
about her! I had no idea that
she went all the way over to
Lighthalzen! Ha ha! Ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
是...是的！沒錯！
因為我太擔心她了！
我完全不知道她
竟然去了那麼遠的裡希塔樂鎮！
哈哈！哈哈！

scripts.text:

[{0}]

in Lighthalzen, you went
to Freya's Spring, all
by yourself, didn't you?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以趁她去裡希塔樂鎮
的時候，你一個人
去了芙蕾雅之泉，對吧？！

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
......
.........
Um? ...Yes.

[{0}]
...............................
(^333333Nuts! I think that
backfired, so I'm going
to have to try this again.)^000000

[{0}]
Wait a second! Your break-up
and Bruspetti's sudden need
to investigate something in
Lighthalzen... They're related
somehow, aren't they?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等一下！你的分手
和布魯斯佩蒂突然需要
去裡希塔樂鎮調查某事...
這兩件事
肯定有關聯，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
......
.........
No! It's not true!

[{0}]
Hmm... Why are you
always hanging out at

And why has Bruspetti
not returned home yet?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯... 為什麼你總是
一個人待在芙蕾雅之泉？
而且布魯斯佩蒂
為什麼還沒回家？

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
...Will you stop talking nonsense?
What is your evidence to convict me with the crime?
I don't wish to hear you any longer.
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
...你能不能別胡說八道？
你有什麼證據能定我的罪？
我不想再聽你廢話了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Even after you killed Bruspetti,
you became worried about another possibility.
So you were plotting to get rid of the possibility, too.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
即使你殺了布魯斯佩蒂，
你還是很擔心另一種可能性。
所以你也在謀劃
如何消除那種可能性。

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
No! Stop it! Stop!
Are you implying that
I killed her?! I didn't!
Quit this nonsense
before I get really angry!
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
不！住口！住手！
你是在暗示
是我殺了她嗎？！我沒有！
在我真的發火之前
停止這種胡言亂語！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Freya's Spring.
Why are you always
hanging around there
by yourself, eh?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
芙蕾雅之泉。
為什麼你總是
一個人待在那裡，嗯？

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
...............................
It's because I really
miss my ex-girlfriend.

[{0}]
Oh. Right.
That's a pretty
good reason.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦。原來是這樣。
這確實是個
不錯的理由。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If Bruspetti is not
your girlfriend, then...
Who is?! Answer that!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果布魯斯佩蒂
不是你的女朋友，那麼...
她是誰？！回答我！

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
...............................
Fine, fine. You win.
She was my ex-girlfriend.
I just don't like talking
about Bruspetti, that's all.
Now will you leave me alone?
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
...............................
好吧，好吧。你贏了。
她是我前女友。
我只是不喜歡談論布魯斯佩蒂，僅此而已。
現在你能讓我清淨一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(^333333Nuts! He wasn't supposed
to cave in like that! I need
to question him again until
my gut feeling is satisfied!^000000)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(^333333可惡！他居然這麼快就
招了！我得繼續審問，
直到我的直覺得到滿足為止！^000000)

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
Oh, it's you again.
What do you want now?
I just told you that I'm not
in the mood for talking with
anyone. I'm still coping with
breaking up with my girlfriend.
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
哦，又是你啊。
這次又想怎樣？
我剛說過，我現在
沒心情跟任何人說話。
我還在為分手的事
調整心情呢。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Katinshuell... I get the
feeling that you're hiding
something. By any chance,
was Bruspetti your girlfriend?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
卡廷舒爾...我總覺得
你在隱瞞什麼。順便問一下，
布魯斯佩蒂是你的女朋友嗎？

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
Huh?! Er, wh-wh-what?
What makes you think that?
That's none of your business!
Besides, don't you think that
a girl like her is too good
for some guy like me?!
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
哈？呃，什-什麼？
你憑什麼這麼想？
這跟你沒關係！
再說了，你覺得像她那樣的女孩
配得上像我這樣的傢伙嗎？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't have any real
reason to suspect you of
anything, but my gut feeling
and the way you reacted isn't
very reassuring. Well, I guess
I can flip through this book...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我其實沒有確鑿的證據
懷疑你什麼，但我的直覺
和你剛才的反應
讓我很不放心。好吧，我想
我可以翻翻這本書...

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
Hey! Hey that's...
That's Bruspetti's diary!
I-I've been looking for-- um...
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
喂！喂，那是...
那是布魯斯佩蒂的日記！
我-我一直在找-- 呃...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey! How would you
know about that?!
Tell me the truth!
Actually, you know what?
Why don't we look at the
truth together? How's that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
喂！你怎麼會知道
那是什麼？！
告訴我實話！
其實，你知道嗎？
我們要不一起看看
真相吧？怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou nonchalantly
toss the diary at
Katinshuell's feet,
and it opens to one of
the pages in the middle.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你漫不經心地把日記
扔在卡廷舒爾腳邊，
它正好翻到了
中間的一頁。^000000

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
......!

[Katinshuell]
Argh! I'm so depressed.
Honestly, I just want to
be left by myself for a really
long time. What the heck do you
want to ask me about, anyway?
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
啊！我好鬱悶。
說實話，我只想
一個人待很久很久。
你到底還想問我什麼？

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
Lighthalzen...?
a city in the Schwarzwald
Republic. That, and it's
a tough place to live in.
That's all I really know...
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
裡希塔樂鎮...
修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國
的一座城市。除此之外，
那裡生活條件很艱苦。
我就知道這麼多...

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
...It's been a while
since I heard that name.
Bruspetti... She's pretty
popular around this town...
Everyone liked her. Is that
all you wanted to know?
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
...我已經很久
沒聽到這個名字了。
布魯斯佩蒂...她在鎮上
挺受歡迎的...
大家都喜歡她。你問的
就是這些嗎？

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
Freya's Spring...
That's just a park
where old people and
couples sort of hang out.
I don't like going there,
though. You shouldn't, either.
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
芙蕾雅之泉...
那只是一個公園，
老人們和情侶們
常去那裡閒逛。
我不喜歡去那裡，
你也不該去。

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
...{0}?
What? I don't understand you...
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
...{0}？
什麼？我不明白你在說什麼...

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
You happy, now?
Quit trying to pry into
my personal business,
and just enjoy touring this
little town. That's what
you came to do, right?
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
你滿意了？
別再打探我的私事了，
好好享受在這個小鎮的
旅程吧。你本來就是
來旅遊的吧？

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
Uh... 
I just told you that I broke
up with my girlfriend. You
know, I kinda sorta wanna
be left alone. Go away...
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
呃...
我剛說過，我和女朋友
分手了。你知道的，我有點
想一個人靜靜。走吧...

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
Eh? Oh, it's one of you
guys, those do-gooder
adventurers. You must not
have anything else to do...
Otherwise, why talk to me?
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
呃？哦，是你們啊，
那些愛管閒事的冒險者。
看來你們沒什麼正事要忙...
不然，為什麼要來找我？

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
Geez... I know you guys go
around solving problems,
but this is one thing you
can't handle. Me and my
girlfriend are history now.
It's over between us.
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
真是的...我知道你們到處
解決問題，但這事你們
管不了。我和我女朋友
已經結束了。
我們之間完了。

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
You're an adventurer,
so I don't think you'd 
understand how difficult
it is to live a quiet, peaceful
life. When you've lived through
certain things, it's tough.
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
你是冒險者，
我想你無法理解
安靜、平靜地生活
有多難。經歷過某些事之後，
日子就很難過了。

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
When you're busy, you're
distracted. But even if I'm
left all alone, these thoughts
of mine never cease to haunt me...
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
忙碌的時候，你會分心。
但即使我獨自一人，
這些念頭也從未停止
糾纏著我...

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
I don't need any more
excitement in my life.
I just want to live quietly,
away from other people,
and to be left all alone for
some semblance of peace.
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
我的生活不需要
更多的刺激了。
我只想安靜地活著，
遠離人群，
獨自待著，
尋求一點安寧。

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
Do you believe in karma?
I do... No matter what you
do, even if you don't get
caught, somehow it just
catches up to you.
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
你相信因果報應嗎？
我相信...無論做什麼，
即使沒被抓到，
終究會報應到身上。

scripts.text:
[Katinshuell]
Have you ever felt
guilty about something,
but hid from the truth?
Let me tell you that it must
be a painful experience. It's
better to confess when you can.
scripts.translation:
[卡廷舒爾]
你有沒有對某件事
感到愧疚，
卻逃避真相？
讓我告訴你，那一定
很痛苦。能坦白時
最好坦白。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Shendar]
When will my precious
daughter Bruspetti be
coming home? I'm sure that
she can take care of herself,
but a father can't help but
worry himself to death.
scripts.translation:
[申達爾先生]
我親愛的女兒布魯斯佩蒂
什麼時候能回家？我相信
她能照顧好自己，
但做父親的難免
擔心得死去活來。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Shendar]
Ah, if you happen to
see my daughter in your
travels, please tell her
that her daddy is waiting
for her to come home.
Thanks, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[申達爾先生]
啊，如果你在旅途中
看到我的女兒，請告訴她
爸爸在等她回家。
謝謝，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Shendar]
So you have a pretty
good idea of who was
sneaking around my house?
scripts.translation:
[申達爾先生]
看來你對誰在我家
鬼鬼祟祟
已經心裡有數了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I suspect this guy
named Katinshuell because
he might have been Bruspetti's
boyfriend and he's been acting
funny. Still, I don't have any
real evidence of that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我懷疑那個叫卡廷舒爾
的傢伙，因為他可能是
布魯斯佩蒂的男朋友，
而且他行為很古怪。
不過，我並沒有
確鑿的證據。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Shendar]
Bruspetti's boyfriend?!
Hmpf! I don't like that
boy already. I haven't
met him yet, but its my
solemn duty as a father
to hate and distrust him!
scripts.translation:
[申達爾先生]
布魯斯佩蒂的男朋友？！
哼！我一開始就不喜歡
那個小子。我還沒見過他，
但作為父親，我有責任
討厭並懷疑他！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Shendar]
Hey! Hey! Are you
the pervert that's been
sneaking into my house
to prey on my daughter?!
scripts.translation:
[申達爾先生]
嘿！嘿！你就是那個
潛入我家
對我女兒圖謀不軌的
變態嗎？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wha--?
No, I'm just a--

[{0}]
Ow! What did
you do that for?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哎喲！你幹嘛
那樣做？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Shendar]
Still alive, eh? Hmpf!
I'll finish you off! I'll...
Er, huh?! Wait, I think
I know you. You're that
adventurer that's been
here before, right?
scripts.translation:
[申達爾先生]
還活著啊？哼！
我要解決你！我要...
呃，咦？！等等，我覺得
我認識你。你是之前
來過這裡的冒險者，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Shendar]
Oh... I think I've made
a mistake. I thought you
were that person that's
been prowling around my
house. I don't know who he,
but I'm sure it's not you...
scripts.translation:
[申達爾先生]
哦...我想我搞錯了。
我以為你是那個
在我家附近徘徊的人。
我不知道他是誰，
但肯定不是你...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, wait...
So someone has been
sneaking around here?
That's weird. Wait, that
guy, the one that might
be Bruspetti's boyfriend...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，等等...
所以有人一直
在這裡鬼鬼祟祟？
真奇怪。等等，那個傢伙，
可能是布魯斯佩蒂
男朋友的那個...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Right, his name was
Katinshuell. That guy's
been acting really funny.
Maybe he was the one sneaking
around here? I'd better go
and ask him about this...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
對，他叫卡廷舒爾。那個傢伙
行為真的很古怪。
也許就是他在這裡
鬼鬼祟祟？我得去
問問他...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Shendar]
Wait, where are
you going? I... I'm
sorry for hitting you?
scripts.translation:
[申達爾先生]
等等，你要去哪？
我...對不起，剛才打你了？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Shendar]
Curses! If that guy is my
daughter's boyfriend, and he's
trespassing into my home, then
he could be really dangerous.
It's too bad that I can't ask
Bruspetti anything about him...
scripts.translation:
[申達爾先生]
該死！如果那個傢伙是我女兒的男朋友，
還擅闖我家，那他可能非常危險。
真可惜，我沒法向布魯斯佩蒂
打聽他的情況...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Shendar]
Hm... Alright, adventurer.
If you can find it, I'll allow
you to take and read my
daughter's diary. We need
to learn more about this guy
Katinshuell. If he's dangerous...
scripts.translation:
[申達爾先生]
嗯...好吧，冒險者。
如果你能找到，我就允許
你拿走並閱讀我女兒的日記。
我們需要了解更多關於
卡廷舒爾這個人的事。如果他危險的話...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Shendar]
I'm sorry... I'm asking you
for your help... But there's
nothing else I can do as her
father. Besides, adventurers
like you can offer her the
best protection...
scripts.translation:
[申達爾先生]
抱歉...我在請求你的幫助...
但作為她的父親，我別無他法。
況且，像你這樣的冒險者
能給她最好的保護...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Shendar]
Curses! I should have never
mentioned my daughter's
diary to an adventurer like
you! I know that your kind
is naturally too curious...!
scripts.translation:
[申達爾先生]
該死！我當初就不該
向你這樣的冒險者提起
我女兒的日記！我知道你們
天生好奇心太重...！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Shendar]
What? My daughter went
to Lighthalzen? She doesn't
know anyone there. Hmm, maybe
that's the place where she was
planning to go to learn more
about what was bothering her.
scripts.translation:
[申達爾先生]
什麼？我女兒去了裡希塔樂鎮？
她在那裡應該不認識人。
嗯，也許那是她計劃去
瞭解困擾她之事的地方。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Shendar]
Yes, she was very generic:
''Dad, I need to go somewhere.''
and ''There's something I need
to make sure of.'' Leaving out
all the details does not put
a doting father at ease!
scripts.translation:
[申達爾先生]
是的，她話說得很籠統：
“爸爸，我要去個地方。”
還有“有些事我需要確認。”
不透露細節，可讓
疼愛女兒的父親不安心啊！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Shendar]
Well, thank you for letting
me know where she might be.
Now, I wish I knew what she
was planning on doing. Maybe
she wrote something about it
in her diary? Yes, perhaps...
scripts.translation:
[申達爾先生]
嗯，謝謝你告訴我
她可能在的地方。
現在，我真想知道她打算做什麼。
也許她在日記裡寫了什麼？
是的，也許...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Shendar]
No! I can't do it!
As a loving father, I can't
allow myself to invade my
precious daughter's privacy.
Even if she did carelessly leave
her diary on top of her drawer.
scripts.translation:
[申達爾先生]
不！我不能這麼做！
作為一個慈愛的父親，我不能
侵犯我珍貴女兒的隱私。
即使她不小心把日記
留在了抽屜頂上。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Shendar]
Oh, but how a father
worries. Will my sweet,
darling Bruspetti be alright?
scripts.translation:
[申達爾先生]
噢，父親總是這麼擔憂。
我甜美可愛的布魯斯佩蒂
會沒事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Shendar]
I miss my daughter. Yes,
the house smells different
without her around. It's a little
weird to be talking about this,
but Bruspetti always did smell
nice, just like her mother.
scripts.translation:
[申達爾先生]
我想我女兒了。是的，
沒有她在，家裡的味道都不一樣了。
說這些有點奇怪，
但布魯斯佩蒂身上總是
很香，就像她母親一樣。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Shendar]
Even if they didn't wear
perfume, they had this
distinctively pleasant
scent about them. I guess
it must be pheremonal?
scripts.translation:
[申達爾先生]
即使她們沒噴香水，
身上也有種獨特的
宜人氣味。我想
那一定是費洛蒙？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Shendar]
Take my advice: never
have a daughter! You worry
too much about them, and they
neglect their parents once
they grow up! I bet she's
having a grand old time...
scripts.translation:
[申達爾先生]
聽我的勸：千萬別
生女兒！你會為她們
擔心太多，而她們長大後
就會忽略父母！我敢打賭
她現在正玩得開心...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Shendar]
Confound it...!
Whoever that guy is,
he better not try any funny
business! As her father, I have
the legal right to wring his
little neck! At least, I should...
scripts.translation:
[申達爾先生]
該死...！
不管那個傢伙是誰，
他最好別耍什麼花樣！
作為她的父親，我有
合法權利擰斷他的脖子！
至少，我應該...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Shendar]
I just found out that
my precious daughter has
been going out with someone.
She went to some other town
for this boy, and I haven't
heard a word from her since!
scripts.translation:
[申達爾先生]
我剛發現我珍貴的女兒
在和某人交往。
她去了另一個城鎮
為了那個男孩，從那以後
我就沒收到她的訊息！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Shendar]
Take my advice: never
have a daughter! You worry
too much about them, and they
neglect their parents once
they grow up! I bet she's
having a grand old time...
scripts.translation:
[申達爾先生]
聽我的勸：千萬別
生女兒！你會為她們
擔心太多，而她們長大後
就會忽略父母！我敢打賭
她現在正玩得開心...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Shendar]
Probably on some lovey
dovey trip with whoever that
boy is. She's been gone an
awful long time, but she's
also an adult now. I... I guess
she should be just fine.
scripts.translation:
[申達爾先生]
大概是在和那個男孩
度蜜月吧。她離開很久了，
但她現在也是大人了。
我...我想她應該沒事。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Shendar]
I just found out that
my precious daughter has
been going out with someone.
She went to some other town
to see this boy, and I haven't
heard a word from her since!
scripts.translation:
[申達爾先生]
我剛發現我珍貴的女兒
在和某人交往。
她去了另一個城鎮
見那個男孩，從那以後
我就沒收到她的訊息！

Take my advice: never
have a daughter! You worry
too much about them, and they
neglect their parents once
they grow up! I bet she's
having a grand old time...
scripts.translation:
[申達爾先生]
聽我的勸：千萬別
生女兒！你會為她們
擔心太多，而她們長大後
就會忽略父母！我敢打賭
她現在正玩得開心...

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
If you happen to see
Bruspetti, tell her to
come talk to me. I need
to know whether I figured
out who her boyfriend is!
I can't wait to see her~
scripts.translation:
[拉謝倫]
如果你碰巧見到布魯斯佩蒂，
請告訴她來找我談談。
我需要知道是否猜對了
她男朋友的身份！
我迫不及待想見她~

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
Oh, hello again~
Is there any way I can
help you this time? I know
you're looking for Bruspetti,
so I'll help you if you have
any questions for me~
scripts.translation:
[拉謝倫]
噢，又見面了~
這次有什麼我能幫你的嗎？
我知道你在找布魯斯佩蒂，
所以如果你有任何問題
都可以問我~

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
Lighthalzen? Oh, that's
right! Bruspetti did ask
me about Lighthalzen a while
ago. Yes, she seemed really
interested in learning more
about that place recently.
scripts.translation:
[拉謝倫]
裡希塔樂鎮？噢，對了！
布魯斯佩蒂之前確實
問過關於裡希塔樂鎮的事。
是的，她最近似乎對
那個地方很感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
Freya's Spring?
Oh, I like that place!
Speaking of which, I know
someone named Katinshuell
that went there pretty often.
Usually men don't go alone...
scripts.translation:
[拉謝倫]
芙蕾雅之泉？
噢，我喜歡那個地方！
說起來，我認識一個叫卡廷舒爾的人，
他經常去那裡。
通常男生不會一個人去那裡...

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
Wait, that's the place
I told you about, where
Bruspetti and her boyfriend
usually met. Do you think
she and Katinshuell...?
Ooh, maybe I figured it out!
scripts.translation:
[拉謝倫]
等等，那是我之前告訴你的地方，
布魯斯佩蒂和她男朋友通常在那裡見面。
你覺得她跟卡廷舒爾...
噢，也許我猜對了！

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
But yeah, that place is
usually filled with couples,
so you look like a real loser
if you go there alone. That's
why I want a boyfriend now...
scripts.translation:
[拉謝倫]
不過那裡通常都是情侶，
如果你一個人去，看起來會很可憐。
所以我現在想要一個男朋友...

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
Oh, I'm sorry...
I don't know anything
about {0}.
scripts.translation:
[拉謝倫]
噢，對不起...
我不認識{0}。

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
Well, I don't know if
you learned anything
important from me,
but I hope I helped
you, even if it was
just a little bit.
scripts.translation:
[拉謝倫]
嗯，我不知道你是否從我這裡
學到了什麼重要的事，
但希望我幫到了你，
哪怕只是一點點也好。

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
Let's see... Bruspetti
and her guy would usually
meet at... Um, I know where
it is by feel, but I can't really
give you good directions
to get there. Er, sorry!
scripts.translation:
[拉謝倫]
讓我想想...布魯斯佩蒂
和她男朋友通常會在...嗯，
我憑感覺知道在哪裡，
但我真的沒法給你指路。
呃，抱歉！

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
Luckily, this town
isn't that big, so I'm
sure you'll find something
if you just keep looking.
Oh, and if you find her,
tell her I said ''hi,'' okay?
scripts.translation:
[拉謝倫]
幸好這個城鎮不大，
只要你一直找，肯定能找到的。
噢，如果你見到她，
替我跟她說聲“嗨”，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
Oh, Bruspetti's dad
was talking about how
good she smells? Yeah,
she's kinda famous for
that around here, so he's
not creepy or anything.
scripts.translation:
[拉謝倫]
噢，布魯斯佩蒂的爸爸
在說她身上的香味？是的，
她在這方面在當地挺有名的，
所以他不是變態之類的。

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
I see, so you think you
caught wind of her in some
other town. Yeah, I heard
that she went traveling to see
if she could learn something,
and she hasn't returned yet.
scripts.translation:
[拉謝倫]
原來如此，所以你覺得你在
其他城鎮聞到了她的氣息。
是的，我聽說她出去旅行了，
想看看能不能學到點什麼，
她還沒回來。

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
Oh, you know what?
If she's in Lighthalzen,
she's probably gone there to
learn more about her boyfriend.
Bruspetti mentioned something
about that when I last saw her.
scripts.translation:
[拉謝倫]
噢，你知道嗎？
如果她在裡希塔樂鎮，
她可能是去那裡瞭解她男朋友的。
上次見到她時，布魯斯佩蒂
提到了這件事。

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
I don't know anything
else. Hmm, maybe if you
check the place where she
and her boyfriend usually
went on dates, you might
be able to find something.
scripts.translation:
[拉謝倫]
我不知道其他的事了。嗯，
也許如果你去她和男朋友
通常約會的地方看看，
你可能會找到一些線索。

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
Ooh, I'm so jealous
of Bruspetti! She's been
spending so much time with
her new boyfriend recently...
But she still refuses to tell
me what his name is.
scripts.translation:
[拉謝倫]
噢，我好嫉妒布魯斯佩蒂！
她最近花了很多時間和
她的新男朋友在一起...
但她還是不肯告訴我
他的名字。

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
She told me that she's
serious about him, but
she's also admitted that
she doesn't know much about
him. Let's see... He grew up in Lighthalzen? That's all she knows.
scripts.translation:
[拉謝倫]
她告訴我她很認真，
但也承認對他了解不多。
讓我想想...他在裡希塔樂鎮長大？
這是她唯一知道的。

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
My friend Bruspetti
is a really nice girl~
Everyone loves her, and
she's sooo beautiful. All
the guys are jealous of
her new boyfriend!
scripts.translation:
[拉謝倫]
我的朋友布魯斯佩蒂
是個非常好的女孩~
大家都喜歡她，
她超級漂亮。所有的男生
都嫉妒她的新男朋友！

scripts.text:
[Lachellen]
Still, she's really
shy, and won't tell me
who he is. There's a lot
I don't know about him, but
I'm sure they're happy together.
scripts.translation:
[拉謝倫]
不過，她真的很害羞，
不肯告訴我他是誰。關於他
我有很多不知道的，
但我相信他們在一起很幸福。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hey, have you seen
Bruspetti? She's really
nice and always buys me
lots and lots of cookies!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嘿，你見過布魯斯佩蒂嗎？
她人很好，總是給我買
很多很多餅乾！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hmm, I haven't seen
her in a while, though.
I heard she went traveling
somewhere. How long do
you think she'll be gone, huh?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嗯，我有一段時間沒見到她了。
我聽說她去哪裡旅行了。
你覺得她會離開多久呢？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Oh wow! I wanna be an
adventurer like you when
I grow up! Go to all sorts
of places, visit different
towns. It sounds so fun!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
噢哇！我長大後想成為
像你一樣的冒險者！
去各種各樣的地方，
參觀不同的城鎮。聽起來好有趣！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Maybe if I find a really
nice place, maybe I'll just
stay and then move there.
There's somewhere here
that did that, and moved
from Lighthalzen to here~
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
也許如果我找到一個
非常好的地方，我就會留下來
然後搬過去。這裡有個地方
就是這樣做的，從裡希塔樂鎮搬到了這裡~

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Yeah, as soon as I get
a chance, I'm gonna ditch
this town and see as much
of the world as I can! I need
to grow up faster than this!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
是的，一旦有機會，
我就要離開這個城鎮，
去看看這個世界！我需要
快點長大才行！

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
When you get to be my
age, you'll cherish all
of your memories, even if
the experience was hurtful
when it actually happened.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
等你到了我這個年紀，
你就會珍惜所有的回憶，
哪怕當時經歷的是痛苦。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Your memories are part
of who you are and what
makes you unique. I can
appreciate living the life
that I have, even if it's
not particularly special.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
回憶是你的一部分，
也是讓你與眾不同的原因。
我很感激自己擁有的生活，
即使它並不特別。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
When you get to be my
age, you appreciate life
more and can release your
regrets more easily. I wasted
much of my youth in needless
worry when I could've relaxed.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
到了我這個年紀，
你會更懂得珍惜生活，
也更容易放下遺憾。
我年輕時浪費了很多時間
在無謂的擔憂上，
本可以放鬆一下的。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Oh, back again, eh?
I guess you must really
like coming to this place
too. Hm, that reminds me...
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
噢，又回來了啊？
看來你真的很喜歡
來這個地方呢。嗯，這讓我想起...

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
See the edge of the spring?
The same young man frequently
comes to that spot, and stares
into the water, just dripping with sadness. Someone so young
shouldn't be feeling like that.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
你看泉水的邊緣嗎？
經常有個年輕男子
來到那裡，盯著水面看，
滿臉都是悲傷。
這麼年輕的人
不該有那樣的神情。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
You're supposed to come
here to relax and enjoy
the surrounding beauty,
not wallow in your sorrow.
I guess that boy doesn't
agree with me on that.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
你來這裡應該是為了
放鬆身心，欣賞美景，
而不是沉浸在悲傷裡。
我想那個男孩
並不認同我的看法。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
You should be able
to let go of whatever's
bothering you, and just
enjoy life as it is now.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
你應該能放下
那些困擾你的事情，
好好享受當下的生活。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
I love this place,
its beautiful scenary
and serene atmosphere.
It's so heavenly peaceful.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
我愛這個地方，
它美麗的景色
和寧靜的氛圍。
真是如天堂般安詳。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
It brings my heart joy to see
young couples can coming
here and relaxing together.
Isn't love a grand thing?
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
看到年輕的情侶
來這裡一起放鬆，
我心裡充滿了喜悅。
愛情真是美好的事物啊？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This...
This smell...
It smells so nice!
Like rose petals riding
on a gentle breeze...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這...
這股氣味...
聞起來好香！
就像玫瑰花瓣
乘著微風飄來...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, could this be
the scent that Bruspetti's
father mentioned earlier?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，這難道是
布魯斯佩蒂的父親
之前提到的氣味嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Just looking at this
spring makes me think
of Bruspetti. What really
happened to her? I get
the feeling that she
caved in to despair.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
光是看著這泉水
就讓我想起布魯斯佩蒂。
她到底發生了什麼？
我感覺她
是被絕望吞沒了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The water's not that
cold, or very deep...
And Katinshuell mentioned
that her body went limp...
But she was still looking
at him. It's haunting...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
水並不冷，
也不深...
卡廷舒爾說
她的身體變得僵硬...
但她當時還在看著他。
這太令人毛骨悚然了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I suppose she was torn...
She loved him, but couldn't
bear to live with his secret.
In the end, it's all so very
tragic. Katinshuell isn't
really a bad person...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想她當時很痛苦...
她愛他，
卻無法忍受帶著他的秘密活下去。
到頭來，一切都
太悲劇了。卡廷舒爾
並不是一個壞人...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He was forced to
commit a heinous crime,
and kept making mistakes,
running from his guilt. Is
anyone accountable for this?
Who would be to blame?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他被迫犯下了
滔天罪行，
之後又不斷犯錯，
逃避自己的罪責。
這一切該由誰負責？
該責怪誰呢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Somehow, I wish that
Katinshuell had the
strength to face his
guilt, and then to
forgive himself.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不知為何，我希望
卡廷舒爾能有勇氣
面對自己的罪責，
然後原諒自己。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This must be where
Bruspetti drowned...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這裡應該就是
布魯斯佩蒂溺亡的地方...

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Oh! Excuse me,
young adventurer,
but you mustn't stand
there! It's very slippery.
What if you fall into the
spring? It's dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
噢！抱歉，
年輕的冒險者，
你不可以站在這裡！
這裡很滑。
萬一你掉進泉水裡怎麼辦？
很危險的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh... Er, thank you.
Yes, I wouldn't want
to get myself drowned.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
噢...呃，謝謝。
是的，我可不想
把自己淹死。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Drowned...? I just
wouldn't want you to
get your clothes wet.
The water isn't that deep...
Even if you can't swim, you
can climb out, you know.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
淹死...？我只是
不想你弄溼衣服而已。
水並不深...
即使你不會游泳，
你也可以爬出來的，你知道嗎。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That old woman told
be to be careful not to
slip and fall into the water
around here, so I'd better
make sure I tread carefully.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
剛才那位老奶奶告訴我，
要小心腳下，別滑倒掉進水裡。
所以我最好還是小心點走。

scripts.text:
[???]
Oh, be very careful!
You don't want to get
too close to the water.
What if you slip and fall?
scripts.translation:
[???]
噢，請非常小心！
你不想離水太近吧。
萬一滑倒掉下去怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Oh, I'm sorry if
I startled you, but the
ground that you're standing
on is very slippery, you know.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
噢，抱歉嚇到你了，
但你站的地方非常滑，你知道嗎。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, I see.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，我明白了。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is where you
found Bruspetti's diary.
Perhaps you should take
it with you the next time
you talk to Katinshuell.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這是你發現藍色的日記本的地方。
也許下次和卡廷舒爾說話時，
你應該把它帶上。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis must be
Bruspetti's diary!
You now have permission
to take it with you so that
you can figure out if she and
Katinshuell are connected...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這一定是藍色的日記本！
你現在可以把它帶走了，
以便弄清楚她和卡廷舒爾是否有聯絡...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis must be
Bruspetti's diary!
But... reading it
would make you feel
like a real creep.
So don't touch it.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這一定是藍色的日記本！
但是...讀它的話，
你會覺得自己像個變態。
所以別碰它。^000000

[烏爾斯蒂拉]
願弗蕾雅永遠
以她無盡的恩典與智慧
保護和指引你。

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
Oh, are you an adventurer
from the outside? Praise be
to Freya! Her love and grace
reaches all over the world,
touching even the hearts of
foreigners, leading them here!
scripts.translation:
[烏爾斯蒂拉]
噢，你是外來的冒險者嗎？
讚美弗蕾雅！她的愛與恩典
遍及全世界，
甚至觸動了異鄉人的心，
引領他們來到這裡！

scripts.text: Freya? I'd like to know more.
scripts.translation: 弗蕾雅？我想多瞭解一些。

scripts.text: That's crazy talk!
scripts.translation: 這太瘋狂了！

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
The day is coming when
Freya will resurrect and
lead all of her faithful to
Valhalla. Now she is in a
deep sleep, but even then,
she watches over all of us.
scripts.translation:
[烏爾斯蒂拉]
那一天終將到來，
弗蕾雅將復活，
帶領所有忠實的信徒
前往瓦爾哈拉。現在她正在
沉睡，但即便如此，
她也在守護著我們所有人。

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
You see, Freya used up
all of her power fighting the
most fearsome of demons
in the Thousand Year War.
Now she rests and recovers
in a pure and sacred place.
scripts.translation:
[烏爾斯蒂拉]
你看，弗蕾雅在千年戰爭中
耗盡了所有力量，
與最可怕的惡魔戰鬥。
現在她在一個純淨神聖的地方
休息和恢復。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait...
How do you
know that all of
this happened?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等...
你怎麼知道
這一切都發生過？

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
These are truths that all
of Freya's worshippers know.
Freya delivers her messages to
us through her mortal vessel,
our beautiful pope that shines
with brilliant white light.
scripts.translation:
[烏爾斯蒂拉]
這些都是所有弗蕾雅信徒
都知道的真理。
弗蕾雅通過她的凡間容器
向我們傳達資訊，
那就是我們美麗的教皇，
她閃耀著耀眼的白光。

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
Unfortunately, even the most
faithful experience lapses in
judgment. It shames me to
admit that my son Egapeo
is... is guilty of sin.
scripts.translation:
[烏爾斯蒂拉]
不幸的是，即使是最虔誠的信徒
也會犯下判斷失誤。承認這一點讓我感到羞恥，
我的兒子埃加佩奧...是有罪的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sin? What did he
do, if you don't
mind me asking?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
罪？如果不介意的話，
他做了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
I don't know, but Egapeo
has been sick for a while
now. I'm convinced that he
did something to anger Freya
Although he may deserve it,
I'm doing my best to help him.
scripts.translation:
[烏爾斯蒂拉]
我不知道，但埃加佩奧
已經病了一段時間了。我確信他
做了一些惹怒弗蕾雅的事。
雖然也許他罪有應得，
但我正在盡力幫助他。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Wait. What?!

[Urstialla]
I know that if I pray hard
enough and please Freya,
she will forgive my son and
heal him of his illness.
But sometimes prayer isn't
enough... I need to pay tribute.
scripts.translation:
[烏爾斯蒂拉]
我知道，如果我祈禱得足夠虔誠
並取悅弗蕾雅，
她會原諒我的兒子，
並治癒他的疾病。
但有時候祈禱是不夠的...
我需要獻上祭品。

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
I managed to acquire a
necklace of incomparable
beauty from the dwarves.
However, the gems have dulled
with age and need to be shined
before I can offer them to Freya.
scripts.translation:
[烏爾斯蒂拉]
我設法從矮人那裡得到了一條
無與倫比的美麗項鍊。
然而，寶石因年代久遠而黯淡，
在我將其獻給弗蕾雅之前，
需要重新擦亮。

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
However, not just anyone can
shine this special necklace
forged by the Dwarves. I need
someone that knows arcane magic
to help me. I think there's only
one mage that can polish this...
scripts.translation:
[烏爾斯蒂拉]
然而，並非任何人都能擦亮
這條由矮人打造的特殊項鍊。
我需要一位精通奧術魔法的人
來幫我。我想只有
一位魔法師能打磨這個...

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
Maheo, the renown mage with
access to the most powerful
magic spells in the world,
must be able to clean this
necklace's gems! However
There's no way I can reach him.
scripts.translation:
[烏爾斯蒂拉]
馬赫奧，這位擁有世界上最強大
魔法咒語的著名魔法師，
一定能夠清潔這條項鍊的寶石！
但是
我沒辦法聯絡到他。

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
You see, Maheo left on a
journey to subjugate the
ice monsters in the ice cave
to the north, and he hasn't
returned yet. That place is too
dangerous for people like me.
scripts.translation:
[烏爾斯蒂拉]
你看，馬赫奧出發去
征服北方冰洞裡的冰系魔物，
至今未歸。那個地方對像我這樣的人
來說太危險了。

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
I know that you adventurers
regularly travel through those
kinds of areas, so would you
please look for Maheo and ask
him to clean this necklace on
my behalf? Please, for my son...
scripts.translation:
[烏爾斯蒂拉]
我知道你們冒險者
經常穿越那些區域，所以請
幫我尋找馬赫奧，並請求他
代我清潔這條項鍊好嗎？拜託了，為了我的兒子...

scripts.text: But that's none of my business!
scripts.translation: 但這與我無關！

scripts.text: Alright, I'll do it.
scripts.translation: 好吧，我答應。

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
I... I see.
I thought that Freya
had led you to me, but
maybe my prayers haven't
been answered yet. Perhaps
I need to pray more fervently?.
scripts.translation:
[烏爾斯蒂拉]
我...我明白了。
我以為弗蕾雅指引你來到我面前，
但也許我的祈禱還沒有得到回應。
也許我需要更虔誠地祈禱？

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
Thank you so much!
Please, take care of this
necklace and ask Maheo
to restore its luster. Then,
it'll be a fitting tribute to
our loving goddess Freya.
scripts.translation:
[烏爾斯蒂拉]
非常感謝！
請保管好這條項鍊，並請求馬赫奧
恢復它的光澤。然後，
它將是對我們慈愛的女神弗蕾雅
最合適的祭品。

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
...............................
Are you telling me
that you don't believe?
Repent, and may your
heart be opened to Freya!
scripts.translation:
[烏爾斯蒂拉]
...............................
你是在告訴我
你不相信嗎？
懺悔吧，願你的心
向弗蕾雅敞開！

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
Please find Maheo the
Mage and ask him to restore
the beauty of the necklace
I gave you. He should be
fighting monsters in the
ice cave to the north.
scripts.translation:
[烏爾斯蒂拉]
請找到魔法師馬赫奧，
並請求他恢復我給你的
項鍊的美麗。他應該正在
北方的冰洞裡與魔物戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
Oh! My necklace! Thank you!
It's so beautiful! It will
make a wonderful tribute to
Freya! I am certain with this,
my son will get better!
scripts.translation:
[烏爾斯蒂拉]
哦！我的項鍊！謝謝你！
它太美了！這將是對弗蕾雅
最棒的祭品！我相信有了這個，
我的兒子就會好起來的！

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
Here, I know it's not much,
but please accept this as a
token of my appreication for
 what you have done for me.
scripts.translation:
[烏爾斯蒂拉]
拿著，我知道這不算什麼，
但請收下這個，作為我對你
為我所做之事的感激之情。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, let's just say it was
a worthwhile experience
for me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，讓我們說這對
我是一次有價值的經歷吧。

scripts.text:
[Urstialla]
.........
............
May Freya always protect and
guide you and forgive you for
that horrible joke.
scripts.translation:
[烏爾斯蒂拉]
.........
............
願弗蕾雅永遠保護並指引你，
並原諒你那個可怕的玩笑。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, no! The necklace has disappeared!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，不！項鍊不見了！

scripts.text:

May Freya always
protect and guide you
with her everflowing

scripts.translation:

恩典與智慧，
保護並指引你。
