scripts.text:
[Man Stuck in Ice]
H-hello?
Hey! Hey, you!
Help me break this
ice! I need to get
out of here!
scripts.translation:
[困在冰中的男子]
你...你好？
嘿！嘿，你！
幫我把這冰敲碎！
我得從這裡出去！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How did you get
stuck in there?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是怎麼被
困在那裡的？

scripts.text:
[Man Stuck in Ice]
I'll explain everything
later! Just... Just get
this ice off of me!.
scripts.translation:
[困在冰中的男子]
我待會兒再解釋！
快...快幫我把
這冰弄掉！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou cast Fire Bolt at
the ice..^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你對冰塊施放了火箭術。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou hammer at the
ice with all your might.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你使出全力敲打冰塊。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't...
I can't even scratch it
Do you have any ideas?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我做不到...
我連一點痕跡都抓不出來。
你有什麼辦法嗎？

scripts.text:
[Man Stuck in Ice]
This is so humiliating...
Me, the greatest mage
of our age, Maheo, stuck
in this pillar of ice.
scripts.translation:
[困在冰中的男子]
這太丟人了...
像我這樣，我們時代
最偉大的魔法師，馬赫奧，
竟然被困在這根冰柱裡。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait...
You're Maheo?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等...
你是馬赫奧？

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
It's true. You're speaking to
Maheo, the greatest mage,
and master of arcane spells.
I know magic that even High
Wizards can never hope to
learn in their lifetimes!
scripts.translation:
[馬赫奧]
千真萬確。你正在與
最偉大的魔法師、
奧術法術的大師馬赫奧對話。
我掌握的魔法，
連高階巫師窮盡一生
也無法學會！

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Despite my greatness,
I'm a humble man. See?
That's why I always wear
this Mage uniform...
To remind myself of
the value of humility.
scripts.translation:
[馬赫奧]
儘管我如此偉大，
但我依然謙遜。看？
所以我總是穿著
這身法師制服...
時刻提醒我
謙遜的可貴。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So how did you get
stuck in all of this ice?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那你到底是怎麼
被這些冰困住的？

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Actually, this happened
because I was too humble
You see, I underestimated
myself, and the devastating
force of my own magic.
scripts.translation:
[馬赫奧]
其實，這都怪我太謙遜了。
你看，我低估了自己，
也低估了我自身魔法
那毀滅性的力量。

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Yes, this wouldn't have
happened if I wasn't so
humble... Humble and kind.
It all started when I thought
of this cave and how people
sometimes come here to get ice.
scripts.translation:
[馬赫奧]
沒錯，如果我不那麼謙遜...
謙遜且善良，
這一切就不會發生。
事情是這樣的，我想到
這個洞穴，人們有時會
來這裡取冰。

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
I then decided that
I would exterminate these
evil monsters for the good
of the people! The citizens
would feel protected, and
I'd be recognized as a hero!
scripts.translation:
[馬赫奧]
於是我決定，
為了人民的福祉，
消滅這些邪惡的魔物！
市民們會感到安全，
我也會被承認為英雄！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Okay... I suppose
that sounds normal
enough. Go on.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧...我覺得
這聽起來還算正常。
繼續說。

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
I valiantly battled
the Snowiers. They were
no match for my magic!
And so, I decided to just
destroy all of them with
one cast of a magic spell.
scripts.translation:
[馬赫奧]
我英勇地與雪怪戰鬥。
它們根本不是我的對手！
於是，我決定用
一次魔法施放
將它們全部消滅。

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
You know Meteor Storm?
I know another spell like
that... But it's two hundred
times more powerful! Yes...
It has the power of a million
exploding suns! But then...
scripts.translation:
[馬赫奧]
你知道隕石術嗎？
我知道另一個類似的法術...
但它的威力是它的兩百倍！
是的...
它擁有一百萬個爆炸太陽的力量！
但是然後...

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
It was too powerful!
There were tremors, and
flying shards of ice, and
all the flame caused my
clothes to catch on fire!
scripts.translation:
[馬赫奧]
威力太強了！
地面在震動，
冰屑四處飛濺，
而且火焰讓我的
衣服都著火了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You...
you set fire
to your clothes
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你...
你把你的衣服
點著了

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Yes, but not to worry.
I quickly extinguished
those flames with my
powerful Frost Diver spell!
scripts.translation:
[馬赫奧]
是的，但別擔心。
我迅速用我強大的
冰錐術熄滅了
那些火焰！

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
In hindsight...
That may have
been a mistake...
scripts.translation:
[馬赫奧]
回想起來...
那可能
是個錯誤...

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Enough about myself.
What noble pursuit brings
you to this place, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[馬赫奧]
別聽我囉嗦了。
是什麼高貴的追求
把你帶到這個地方，冒險者？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I heard that you can
polish the gems on this
necklace with your magic,
so I came here to find you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我聽說你可以
用魔法打磨這條項鍊上的
寶石，
所以我來這裡找你。

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Verily, I can shine
those gems so that they
shine as brightly as a
million exploding suns!
scripts.translation:
[馬赫奧]
誠然，我可以
讓那些寶石閃耀，
讓它們像一百萬個
爆炸的太陽一樣明亮！

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
That is, as soon
as I can get out
of this ice. Hmm...
But I doubt normal
magic will be able
to melt all of this.
scripts.translation:
[馬赫奧]
也就是說，只要
我能從這冰裡
出來。嗯...
但我懷疑普通的
魔法能融化
這麼多冰。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then how are we
supposed to get
you out of there?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我們該怎麼
把你從那裡
弄出來呢？

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Fear not. I'm sure
that my master will know
of a way to free me from
this prison of ice. He can
be found near Freya's Spring:
beseech him on my behalf!
scripts.translation:
[馬赫奧]
別怕。我相信
我的師父會知道
如何讓我擺脫
這座冰牢。他可以在
芙蕾雅之泉附近找到：
請代我向他求助！

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
My master may not have
my sheer talent, but he
is very knowledgable in
the ways of magic. Please...
Ask him for help. He should
be reading near Freya's Spring.
scripts.translation:
[馬赫奧]
我的師父可能沒有
我那麼大的天賦，
但他對魔法之道
非常博學。請...
向他求助。他應該
在芙蕾雅之泉附近讀書。

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Oh, you're back!
So did my master have
any ideas on breaking
this cold prison of ice?
scripts.translation:
[馬赫奧]
哦，你回來了！
那麼我的師父有沒有
什麼主意能打破
這座冰冷的冰牢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, shoot! I left the necklace in the city! I will be right back!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哎呀！我把項鍊忘在城市裡了！我馬上回來！

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Hey, hey! Can't you just release me first?
scripts.translation:
[馬赫奧]
嘿，嘿！你不能先
把我放出來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
My master may not have
my sheer talent, but he
is very knowledgable in
the ways of magic. Please...
Ask him for help. He should
be reading near Freya's Spring.
scripts.translation:
[馬赫奧]
我的師父可能沒有
我那麼大的天賦，
但他對魔法之道
非常博學。請...
向他求助。他應該
在芙蕾雅之泉附近讀書。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, he made this
magic hammer which is
supposed to be able to
break this magic ice.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，他做了這把
魔法錘子，據說
能打破這魔法冰。

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Of course!
Why didn't I think of
that? Great, now get
me out of here please!
scripts.translation:
[馬赫奧]
當然！
我怎麼沒想到呢？
太好了，現在請
把我弄出來！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou tightly gripped
the Wind Hammer, and
swung it down at the ice
with all of your strength.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你緊緊握住
風之鋼斧，
用盡全力揮向
冰塊。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Pzzzzz*
*CRASH!*^000000

[Maheo]
Finally...!
After all of this
time! I'm free!
scripts.translation:
[馬赫奧]
終於...！
經歷了這麼長時間！
我自由了！

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Now, all of the monsters
in this cave will taste the
wrath of the greatest mage in
the world! I'll have my revenge,
and give those beasts double
the pain that they gave me!
scripts.translation:
[馬赫奧]
現在，這個洞穴裡的
所有魔物都將品嚐
世界最強魔法師的
怒火！我要復仇，
讓那些野獸承受
比它們給我兩倍
的痛苦！

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Muhahahahahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[馬赫奧]
哈哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Er, but first, I need to
use my magic to clean
that necklace of yours.
scripts.translation:
[馬赫奧]
呃，不過首先，
我需要用法術
清理一下你的項鍊。

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Oh! This was made by
the Dwarves, wasn't it?
It looks like they've made
yet another masterpiece.
Shame that this is so
tarnished, though.
scripts.translation:
[馬赫奧]
哦！這是矮人
製作的吧？
看起來他們又
打造了一件傑作。
可惜它變得
這麼髒兮兮的。

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Let's see, now...
scripts.translation:
[馬赫奧]
讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Maheo]
Well, I suppose this
is where we part ways.
Here, take this as a gift...
And please don't mention
the fact that I trapped myself
in ice to anyone else, okay?
scripts.translation:
[馬赫奧]
好了，我想
我們該分別了。
拿著，這是給你的禮物...
還有，請千萬不要告訴別人
我把自己凍在冰裡的事，好嗎？

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在攜帶的物品太多了。
請先使用卡普拉服務
將部分物品存入倉庫，
然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Hamion]
Hm? Did you need
something? If it's not too
important, then I'd like to
get back to reading my book.
scripts.translation:
[哈米翁]
嗯？你需要什麼嗎？
如果不重要的話，
我想繼續看書。

scripts.text:
[Hamion]
Hm? Did you need
something? If it's not too
important, then I'd like to
get back to reading my book.
scripts.translation:
[哈米翁]
嗯？你需要什麼嗎？
如果不重要的話，
我想繼續看書。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um, would you know
a mage by the name
of Maheo? I'm supposed
to go look for his master
around this area.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
請問，您認識
一位名叫馬赫奧的魔法師嗎？
我聽說要去這一帶
尋找他的師父。

scripts.text:
[Hamion]
Well, you've found him
because that would be me.
What happened to Maheo?
scripts.translation:
[哈米翁]
既然你找到了我，
那我就是他的師父。
馬赫奧怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Hamion]
He froze himself?!
Hahahaha! Some genius!
Oh, well, I suppose he still
has plenty to learn about
character, if not magic.
scripts.translation:
[哈米翁]
他把自己凍住了？！
哈哈哈！真是個天才！
唉，看來他在性格方面
還有很多要學的，
雖然魔法方面可能已經不錯了。

scripts.text:
[Hamion]
Let's see, let's see...
This book ought to have
the answer. Mmm... Ah!
Page 42! I need to construct
an artifact in order to break
that mystical ice. Mmm.
scripts.translation:
[哈米翁]
讓我想想...
這本書裡應該有答案。
嗯...啊！
第42頁！我需要製造一件
神器才能打破那層魔法之冰。
嗯。

scripts.text:
[Hamion]
Would you help
me? I need to get
^4D4DFF5 Rough Winds^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Hammer^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Blank Scroll^000000
scripts.translation:
[哈米翁]
你能幫我嗎？
我需要
^4D4DFF5風靈原石^000000、
^4D4DFF1錘子^000000，以及
^4D4DFF1空卷軸^000000

scripts.text:
[Hamion]
You can get Blank Scrolls
in the Sage Academy in Juno.
Ah, and the Hammer is a weapon,
not one of those smithing tools.
I'd help you if I could, but...
I'm just smart, not strong.
scripts.translation:
[哈米翁]
你可以在朱諾的賢者學院
買到空卷軸。
啊，還有，錘子是武器，
不是那種鍛造工具。
如果我能幫忙就好了，但是...
我只是聰明，並不強壯。

scripts.text:
[Hamion]
I need to create
a magical artifact
to break the ice that's
trapping Maheo. Would you
please help me? There's no
way I can get the items myself!
scripts.translation:
[哈米翁]
我需要製造一件
魔法神器來打破
困住馬赫奧的冰。
請幫幫我吧！
我自己絕對拿不到那些材料！

scripts.text:
[Hamion]
I need to get
^4D4DFF5 Rough Winds^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Hammer^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Blank Scroll^000000
scripts.translation:
[哈米翁]
我需要
^4D4DFF5風靈原石^000000、
^4D4DFF1錘子^000000，以及
^4D4DFF1空卷軸^000000

scripts.text:
[Hamion]
You can get Blank Scrolls
in the Sage Academy in Juno.
Ah, and the Hammer is a weapon,
not one of those smithing tools.
I'd help you if I could, but...
I'm just smart, not strong.
scripts.translation:
[哈米翁]
你可以在朱諾的賢者學院
買到空卷軸。
啊，還有，錘子是武器，
不是那種鍛造工具。
如果我能幫忙就好了，但是...
我只是聰明，並不強壯。

scripts.text:
[Hamion]
Great, you have everything
I need! But first, would you
make sure that you only have
1 Hammer in your inventory?
If you have more than one,
I might take the wrong Hammer.
scripts.translation:
[哈米翁]
太好了，你集齊了
我需要的東西！
不過首先，請確認
你的物品欄裡只有一把錘子？
如果你有多把，
我可能會拿錯。

scripts.text: Let me check.
scripts.translation: 讓我檢查一下

scripts.text: Don't worry, I checked.
scripts.translation: 別擔心，我檢查過了

scripts.text:
[Hamion]
Alright, it's always
better to be safe than
sorry! If only Maheo was
a little more careful, more
like you are, then maybe this
wouldn't have happened.
scripts.translation:
[哈米翁]
好的，小心駛得萬年船！
如果馬赫奧能像你一樣
稍微小心一點，
也許就不會發生這種事了。

scripts.text:
[Hamion]
Okay, I'll take your
word for it. Now, let's
bring the artifact forging
process. Hmmm... Let me
review it here on page 45.
scripts.translation:
[哈米翁]
好的，我相信你。
那麼，讓我們開始
鍛造神器吧。
嗯...讓我翻到第45頁
確認一下流程。

scripts.text:
[Hamion]
Here we go...!
scripts.translation:
[哈米翁]
找到了...！

scripts.text:
[Hamion]
...Aaaand now it's done.
Here, take this Wind Hammer
and use it to free Maheo.
This hammer will only work
once, so make sure that you
smash that ice properly!
scripts.translation:
[哈米翁]
...完成了。
拿著這把風之鋼斧，
去解救馬赫奧吧。
這把錘子只能使用一次，
所以一定要確保
能順利砸碎那層冰！

scripts.text:
[Hamion]
There are always
singing birds and
flitting butterflies
all over this place
It's so relaxing, and
such a great place to read.
scripts.translation:
[哈米翁]
這裡到處都有
歌唱的鳥兒和
飛舞的蝴蝶。
這裡非常令人放鬆，
是個讀書的好地方。

scripts.text:
[Mohadian]
I work at the bar around
here, and I've heard good
things about you. Some of
the customers've heard that
you helped Urstialla by going
into that dangerous Ice Cave.
scripts.translation:
[莫哈迪安]
我就在這附近的酒吧工作，
聽說你名聲不錯。有些
顧客聽說你為了幫助
烏爾斯蒂拉，闖入了
那個危險的冰洞。

scripts.text:
[Mohadian]
Now, are you really capable
of regularly defeating the
snow monsters inside there?
If you are, I've got a bit of a
business proposition for you.
scripts.translation:
[莫哈迪安]
那麼，你真的有能力
定期擊敗裡面的
雪怪嗎？
如果是的話，
我有一個小小的商業
提議想跟你談談。

scripts.text:
[Mohadian]
The weather around here
is naturally hot and humid,
so we need ice to make cold,
refreshing drinks at the pub.
And the Ice Cave is the best
place to get that ice, right?
scripts.translation:
[莫哈迪安]
這裡的天氣
天然炎熱潮溼，
所以我們需要冰來
在酒吧製作冰鎮
清爽的飲料。
而冰洞正是獲取
冰塊的最佳地點，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Mohadian]
If you bring me Ice Pieces
from the Ice Cave, I'll buy
them from you at 375 zeny
each. Think of it as kind of a
freelance job. I mean, if you
can bring me ice, I'll buy it!.
scripts.translation:
[莫哈迪安]
如果你能從冰洞
給我帶來冰碎片，
我會以每個375 Zeny
的價格收購。你可以
把它看作是一份自由職業。
我是說，如果你能
給我弄來冰，我就買！

scripts.text:
[Mohadian]
You can make some good
money, my customers can
enjoy ice cold drinks, and
my business will definitely
benefit. We'd kill three birds
with one stone! What do you say?
scripts.translation:
[莫哈迪安]
你可以賺不少錢，
我的顧客可以享用
冰鎮飲料，
我的生意也肯定會
受益。這真是一舉三得！
你覺得怎麼樣？

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然。

scripts.text:
[Mohadian]
Aww, how disappointing.
I was really sure that this
would be a great deal for
both of us. Well, if you're
willing to change your mind
then we can be partners!
scripts.translation:
[莫哈迪安]
哎呀，真令人失望。
我原本以為這對
我們雙方來說
都會是一筆好買賣。
好吧，如果你願意
改變主意，
我們隨時可以合作！

scripts.text:
[Mohadian]
Great! Now, the ice that
I need comes from Glacial
Hearts. You can obtain those
by hunting the snow monsters
in the Ice Cave. Remember, I'll
pay you 375 zeny for each one!
scripts.translation:
[莫哈迪安]
太好了！那麼，我需要的
冰來自冰塊心臟。
你可以通過獵殺冰洞裡的
雪怪來獲得它們。
記住，我會以每個
375 Zeny的價格收購！

scripts.text:
[Mohadian]
Bring me some Glacial
Hearts from the Ice Cave,
and I'll be sure to compensate
you with some zeny. This is a
really good deal for the two
of us when you think about it.
scripts.translation:
[莫哈迪安]
從冰洞給我帶些
冰塊心臟來，
我一定會用Zeny
好好補償你。
仔細想想，這對我們
雙方來說都是一筆
非常划算的交易。

scripts.text:
[Mohadian]
Perfect, you brought me
some Glacial Hearts! I can
never get used to the beauty
and purity of these ice crystals.
scripts.translation:
[莫哈迪安]
完美，你帶給我
一些冰塊心臟！
我從未習慣過這些
冰結晶的美麗與純淨。

scripts.text:
[Mohadian]
Yes, I think I might
even be able to use these
to make Arunafeltz Glacial
Wine. Anyway, let me see
how many you've brought me.
scripts.translation:
[莫哈迪安]
是的，我想我甚至
可以用這些來製作
阿魯納菲茲冰川酒。
不管怎樣，讓我看看
你帶了多少給我。

scripts.text:
[Mohadian]
{0} Glacial Hearts
at 375 zeny each...
Looks like I owe you
{1} zeny. Here you are!
It's always a pleasure
doing business with you~
scripts.translation:
[莫哈迪安]
{0}個冰塊心臟，
每個375 Zeny...
看來我欠你
{1} Zeny。給你！
能與你做生意
總是件樂事~

scripts.text:
[Mohadian]
Welcome to--
Er? Hello?
Excuse me?
scripts.translation:
[莫哈迪安]
歡迎光臨——
呃？你好？
請問？

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe flames in this fire
barrier crackle with magic
power. There's no way that
you can put this fire out
with conventional means.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這火焰屏障中的
