you can put this fire out
with conventional means.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這火焰屏障中的
火焰閃爍著魔力。
用常規手段
根本無法撲滅這火焰。^000000

scripts.text: Use Freezing Snow Powder.
scripts.translation: 使用冰塊粉

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou sprinkle the Freezing Snow
Powder onto the flame. It
flickers before extinguising.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你將冰塊粉撒在
火焰上。火焰閃爍
了幾下後熄滅了。^000000

scripts.text: Use Ice Scale.
scripts.translation: 使用冰塊鱗片

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou throw the Ice Scale into
the flame, it crackles before
extinguising.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你將冰塊鱗片扔進火焰中，火焰噼啪作響後熄滅了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe temple's
entrance is locked.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF神殿的入口被鎖住了。^000000

scripts.text: Kick Door.
scripts.translation: 踢門

scripts.text: Smash Door with Weapon.
scripts.translation: 用武器砸門

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Please don't do that!
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
請不要那樣做！

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Good day, adventurer.
May I ask what brings
you to the temple today?
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
日安，冒險者。
請問您今天來神殿有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text: Just sight-seeing.
scripts.translation: 只是觀光

scripts.text: I came to pray.
scripts.translation: 我來祈禱

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
I guess most foreigners
aren't familiar with our
faith, so I suppose they
wouldn't come here to pray...
Well, I hope you enjoy your
time here, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
我想大多數外國人不熟悉我們的信仰，所以大概不會來這裡祈禱吧...
希望您在這裡度過愉快的時光，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Oh! I'm glad to see that
our kind of spirituality is
practiced in other countries~
You know, we at the Temple of
Cheshrumnir will be hosting a
festival here at the temple.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
哦！很高興看到我們的信仰在其他國家也有實踐~
你知道嗎，瑟斯隆尼勒神殿將在這裡舉辦一場節日慶典。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
We're accepting donations
for the festival, so we'd be
grateful if you could make
a contribution. Regardless,
we invite you to celebrate the
grace of the goddess with us.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
我們正在為節日慶典接受捐贈，如果您能慷慨解囊，我們將不勝感激。無論如何，我們邀請您與我們一起慶祝女神的恩典。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
There's one High Priest that
disagrees with collecting money
from the temple's patrons, but
it's up to you if you want to
give or not. If you donate, you
might be able to win a prize!
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
有一位神官反對向神殿的信徒收取費用，但捐不捐由您決定。如果您捐贈，也許能贏得獎品！

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
You can use our Lottery Tickets
to win something nice from our
Temple Storage. However, you
donate the 50,000 zeny for each
Lottery Ticket, which also happens to be the minimum donation amount.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
您可以使用彩票從神殿倉庫中贏取好東西。每張彩票需要捐贈50,000 Zeny，這也是最低捐贈金額。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
The prizes that are given to
donators are also randomly
chosen, so I have no way of
telling you what you'd get.
Would you be interested
in making a donation?
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
捐贈者獲得的獎品也是隨機抽取的，所以我無法告訴您會獲得什麼。
您有興趣進行捐贈嗎？

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
I understand. Well,
maybe some other time.
May Freya bless you on
all your journeys. May the
grace of the goddess always
support us in all that we do~
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
我理解。那麼，也許下次吧。
願弗蕾雅祝福您所有的旅程。願女神的恩典始終支援我們的一切~

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Great! How much would you
like to donate? We can only
accept donations in increments
of 50,000 zeny, and we can only
accept up to 150,000 zeny at once. It's a bit complicated, I know...
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
太好了！您想捐贈多少？我們只能接受50,000 Zeny的整數倍捐贈，且一次最多接受150,000 Zeny。我知道這有點複雜...

scripts.text: 50,000z - 1 Lottery Ticket
100,000z - 2 Lottery Ticket
150,000z - 3 Lottery Ticket
Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
I understand that it takes
some thought to part with an
amount of money like 50,000
zeny. Even so, Freya is always
protecting you, wherever you go~
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
我理解拿出50,000 Zeny這樣一筆錢需要好好考慮一下。不過，無論您去往何處，芙蕾雅女神都會一直守護著您的~

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Oh, you're {0}!
Welcome back! I remember
that you donated just a little
while ago. So what brings you
to the temple today, hmm?
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
哦，是{0}！
歡迎回來！我記得您剛才才捐贈過。那麼，今天是什麼風把您吹到神殿來了呢，嗯？

scripts.text: I've come to donate again.
scripts.translation: 我又來捐贈了。

scripts.text: Just sight-seeing.
scripts.translation: 只是觀光

scripts.text: I came to attend the service.
scripts.translation: 我來參加儀式。

scripts.text: I just wanted to see you again.
scripts.translation: 我只是想再來看看您。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
You've come to make another
donation? Splendid! How much
would you like to donate this
time? Remember that we can only
accept donations in increments of
50,000 zeny up to 150,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
您又要來捐贈了嗎？太好了！這次您想捐贈多少？請記得我們只能接受50,000 Zeny的整數倍捐贈，且一次最多接受150,000 Zeny。

scripts.text: 50,000z - 1 Lottery Ticket
100,000z - 2 Lottery Ticket
150,000z - 3 Lottery Ticket
Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
I understand that it takes
some thought to part with an
amount of money like 50,000
zeny. Even so, Freya is always
protecting you, wherever you go~
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
我理解拿出50,000 Zeny這樣一筆錢需要好好考慮一下。不過，無論您去往何處，芙蕾雅女神都會一直守護著您的~

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Oh! If you'd like some
information about our temple,
why don't you ask Priestess
Pano at the Help Desk inside?
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
哦！如果您想了解關於神殿的資訊，不妨去裡面的諮詢臺問問女祭司 帕諾？

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Penno will also redeem
your Lottery Tickets for
prizes, although she doesn't
really seem to enjoy that job.
Well, anyway, she'll help
you out. See you later!
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
佩諾也會幫您兌換彩票獎品，雖然她看起來不太喜歡這份工作。總之，她會幫您的。再見啦！

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
You're here for the
service? That's great~
I hope you find the sense
of calm that you can only
get from goddess Freya~
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
您是來參加儀式的嗎？太好了~
希望您能感受到只有芙蕾雅女神才能賜予的寧靜~

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Oh, how sweet of you~
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
哎呀，您真貼心~

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Welcome to our temple!
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
歡迎來到我們的神殿！

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Hello, there!
...............................
Um, for some reason, the
temple gate hasn't opened yet
But it should be open now. Well
this happens sometimes so...
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
你好呀！
...............................
嗯，不知為何，神殿的大門還沒開啟。
但現在應該已經開了才對。這種事偶爾也會發生，所以...

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
See, there's this auto locking
system that was added to the
gate when this temple was
built, but now it's more of
an annoyance than security.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
你看，這座神殿建造時，大門上加裝了一套自動鎖定系統，但現在它帶來的麻煩比安全感還多。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Every time someone messes
with the lock, or if it breaks,
we have to wait until it auto
resets itself before it works
again. No one can fix it
really quickly, you know...
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
每次有人亂動鎖，或者它壞了，我們都得等它自動重置後才能再次使用。沒人能很快修好它，你知道的...

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
^333333*Sniff*^000000 What should I do?
The auto reset never takes
this long, and I really need
to go inside. ^333333*Sob*^000000 P-Panno!
Panno, I neeeed heeeeelp~!
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
^333333*吸鼻子*^000000 我該怎麼辦？
自動重置從來沒這麼久過，而我真的很想進去。^333333*抽泣*^000000 帕-帕諾！
帕諾，我需-需要幫-幫忙~！

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
If the gate's locked, then
I've just got to find that
secret entrance. Some kids
supposedly use it to enter
and play pranks in the temple,
but I don't know who they are...
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
如果大門鎖了，那我只能去找那個秘密入口了。聽說有些小孩用它溜進來在神殿裡惡作劇，但我不知道他們是誰...

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Panno would know
what to do... I think.
Ooh, Panno, help me!
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
帕諾應該知道該怎麼辦...我想。
哦，帕諾，幫幫我！

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Oh, {0}!
The gate just opened and
I was able to get inside
the temple! ^333333*Whew*^000000 I was
getting really worried
about it for awhile.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
哦，{0}！
大門剛才開了，我成功進神殿了！^333333*呼*^000000 剛才我真的擔心了好久。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
This is the first time that the
gate locked up since Panno
was assigned to her post in
the temple. I thought maybe
something happened and
she got in trouble, you know?
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
這是帕諾被分配到神殿崗位以來，大門第一次鎖住。我還以為發生了什麼事，她是不是遇到麻煩了，你知道的？

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Wait, wait...
I'm outside. What if
the gate locks up again?
Oooh, what should I do?!
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
等等，等等...
我在外面。萬一大門又鎖了怎麼辦？
哎呀，我該怎麼辦？！

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Hey, {0}~!
We reached our target!
Isn't that great? We're no
longer asking for donations,
but you can still redeem your
Lottery Tickets inside, okay?
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
嘿，{0}~！
我們達成目標了！
真棒，對吧？我們不再接受捐款了，
不過你仍然可以在裡面兌換彩票哦。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Mmm... I know what
I can do! I can ask for
Firecrackers! Yes, that'll
be fun for the festival.
Hey, do you know where
those things are sold?
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
嗯...我知道可以做什麼了！
我可以要一些爆竹！
是的，節日裡放爆竹會很有趣。
嘿，你知道哪裡賣那些東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
I, uh, can't give you
much... But if you would
bring me some Firecrackers,
then I'll pray for your good
fortune. Sorry, but that's
all I can really offer.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
我...我沒法給你太多...
但如果你能給我一些爆竹，
我會為你祈禱好運。
抱歉，我只能提供這些。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Hey, bring me
a lot of Firecrackers,
like, ^FF000020 of them^000000! Thank
you thank you thank you!
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
嘿，給我帶很多爆竹，
比如，^FF000020個^000000！
謝謝謝謝謝謝！

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Hey, did you bring me
^FF000020 Firecrackers^000000? Mmm?
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
嘿，你帶了^FF000020個爆竹^000000給我嗎？嗯？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No, not yet.
scripts.translation: 不，還沒準備好。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Yay!
Firecrackers!
Oh, let me pray
for your good fortune!
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
耶！
爆竹！
哦，讓我為你祈禱好運！

scripts.text:
^3355FFPriestess Nemma prayed
fervently for your good
fortune. It feels like
it's actually working...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF女祭司 奈瑪
虔誠地為你祈禱好運。
感覺真的有用...^000000

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
I'm done!
Now it's time
to play! Hm, maybe
our pope would like
to see these too?
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
我完成了！
現在該玩了！
嗯，也許我們的教皇
也想看看這些？

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Awww...
This isn't enough
Firecrackers. I mean,
I know it's like a donation,
but still. How much fun are
fireworks if there isn't a lot?
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
哎呀...
爆竹不夠多。
我是說，我知道這像捐款，
但畢竟...如果數量不多，
煙花有什麼好玩的？

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Awww...
Well, I don't really
have much to pay you
back with, anyway~
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
哎呀...
反正我也沒什麼能回報你的~

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Welcome to our temple!
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
歡迎來到我們的神殿！

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
So, {0}...
I just want to make sure:
You want to donate {1}
zeny, and receive {2} Lottery
Ticket. Is that correct?
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
那麼，{0}...
我想確認一下：
你想捐贈{1} Zeny，
並獲得{2}張彩票。對嗎？

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
So, {0}...
I just want to make sure:
You want to donate {1}
zeny, and receive {2} Lottery
Tickets. Is that correct?
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
那麼，{0}...
我想確認一下：
你想捐贈{1} Zeny，
並獲得{2}張彩票。對嗎？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Oh, I see. Well, if you
don't have enough zeny with
you, then you can just come
back and donate later. Our
goddess Freya smiles on the
generous and rewards the patient!
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
哦，我明白了。那麼，如果你
身上沒有足夠的Zeny，
你可以稍後再來捐贈。
我們的女神芙蕾雅
會微笑注視慷慨的人，
並獎勵耐心的人！

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
I can scarcely believe it...
You're carrying so much stuff,
you don't even have enough
room for a Lottery Ticket.
You'd better put some of
your things in Storage, yes?
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
我簡直不敢相信...
你帶了這麼多東西，
連放彩票的空間都沒有。
你最好把一些東西放進倉庫，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Don't worry, I'll still be
here after you make more
space available in your
Inventory. Hurry back, and
donate if you can, okay?
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
別擔心，等你騰出
更多背包空間後，
我還會在這裡。
快點回來，如果能的話就捐贈吧，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
There you are~
Thanks so much for
your donation! I'm sure
that Freya is smiling down
upon you, and will reward
you for your generosity~
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
你來了~
非常感謝你的捐贈！
我相信芙蕾雅
正在微笑著注視你，
並會獎勵你的慷慨~

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
Thank you so much! We'll be
continuing to accept donations
until we reach our target. Once
we receive {0} more donations
in increments of 50,000 zeny,
our fundraiser will finish.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
非常感謝！我們將繼續接受捐款，
直到達到目標。一旦我們
再收到{0}筆捐款，
每筆50,000 Zeny，
我們的募捐活動就會結束。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
If you're feeling so
inclined, come back later
and make another contribution.
Thanks again, and may Freya
always watch over you.
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
如果你願意，稍後再來
做另一筆貢獻。
再次感謝，願芙蕾雅
永遠保佑你。

scripts.text:
[Priestess Nemma]
I'm sorry, but you have
less than {0} zeny...
I know it's asking a lot,
but those are the rules that
I've been told to follow, so...
Well, maybe another time, yes?
scripts.translation:
[女祭司 奈瑪]
抱歉，你的Zeny少於{0}...
我知道這要求很多，
但這是我被要求遵守的規則，所以...
嗯，也許下次吧，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hey! What's that
smile for? You're not
gonna come pat my head,
are you? No! I hate that!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嘿！你笑什麼？
你不會想摸我的頭吧？
不行！我討厭那樣！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Don't come here!
I don't want you to
pat my head! Grrr...
I-I'm warning you!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
別過來！
我不想讓你摸我的頭！
哼...我警告你哦！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hey, look at your
clothes! Where did
you come from, huh?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嘿，看看你的衣服！
你是從哪來的啊？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Are you from a
different country?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
你是從別的國家來的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Huh, huh?
What country
are you from?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嗯？
你來自哪個國家？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Eh, whatever.
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
啊，算了。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Oh hey, do
you like candy?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哦，嘿，
你喜歡糖果嗎？

scripts.text: Not at all.
scripts.translation: 一點都不喜歡。

scripts.text: Yeah.
scripts.translation: 是的。

scripts.text: Sure, I love the stuff~
scripts.translation: 當然，我超愛吃的~

scripts.text: Not much.
scripts.translation: 不太喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hmpf! Okay.
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哼！好吧。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Oh. It's 'cause you're
a grown-up. Why don't
you like candies, anyway?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哦。是因為你是大人嗎？
為什麼大人都不喜歡糖果呢？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Why, huh?
Tell me, tell
me, how come?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
為什麼啊？
告訴我，告訴我，
到底為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Oh yeah...?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哦，是嗎...？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
But you're a grown-up,
aren't you? Heh heh heh!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
不過你是大人，
對吧？嘿嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Candy is only for
kids! Hahahahaah!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
糖果是小孩子吃的！
哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
I tricked you!
You big big dummy!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
我騙到你了！
你這個大笨蛋！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Oh, you do?
Does that mean
that you have
any candy, then?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哦，你喜歡？
那意思是你身上
有糖果嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
I want one!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
我想要一個！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hurry, give me one!
Gimmie gimmie~!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
快點，給我一個！
給我給我~！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Mmm...
If you give me
some Candy, then I'll
tell you something
really cool, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嗯...
如果你給我一些糖果，
我就告訴你一個
超酷的事情，好不好？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Yay~
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
耶~

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hah! Got you!
I didn't want any
candy anyway! Nyeh!
But I like you, so
I can tell you a secret!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哈！騙到你了！
我本來就不想要糖果！
哼！
不過我喜歡你，
所以可以告訴你一個秘密！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Did you know that
they always leave one
of the windows to the temple
unlocked? You spy on the
priests inside. They're always
fighting! Isn't that bad?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
你知道嗎？
他們總是留一扇
通往神殿的窗戶不鎖。
你可以偷看裡面的牧師。
他們總是在打架！
這不好吧？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Oh well, they're adults,
so I dunno. Maybe they...
Mm. Well, I remember that
fighting is supposed to be bad.
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
算了，他們是大人，
所以我不懂。也許他們...
嗯。反正我記得
打架是不好的事情。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Awww, nuts!
I just remembered!
If you have candy, it
must be from another
country! I should have
taken it from you. Dang it!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哎呀，糟糕！
我突然想起來！
如果你有糖果，
那一定是從別的國家帶來的！
我本該搶過來的。真倒霉！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Oooh, I hate you
now! Leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
噢，我現在
討厭你了！
別理我！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
You don't wanna
share your candy?
Hmpf! I guess you
must really love it.
...You big greedy.
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
你不想
分享你的糖果？
哼！看來你
真的很喜歡它。
...你這個大貪心鬼。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Wait, you don't have
any Candy, huh? How can
you tell me you like Candy
when you don't carry any?
Look at this! My pockets
are full of candy!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
等等，你沒有
糖果，是嗎？
你身上沒帶糖果，
怎麼能說你喜歡糖果呢？
看這個！我口袋
裡裝滿了糖果！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
See?
Look at all
this candy!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
看到了嗎？
看看這些
糖果！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Yeah, you have to
have at least this
much candy to say
that you like them.
Hee hee hee hee!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
沒錯，你至少
要有這麼多糖果，
才能說你喜歡糖果。
嘿嘿嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Oh hey...
Would you like to
have some candy?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哦，對了...
你想吃一點
糖果嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Haha! I tricked you!
I'm not gonna share
all this candy with you!
All of it is for me!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哈哈！我又騙到你了！
我才不會把這些糖果
分給你呢！
它們全都是我的！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Oh...
You are mad
at me, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哦...
你是在生我的氣，
對吧？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Okay, okay.
I'll tell you a really
cool secret, so promise
that you won't be mad anymore.
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
好啦，好啦。
我會告訴你一個
超酷的秘密，
所以答應我，
不要再生氣了。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text: What's that?
scripts.translation: 那是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Please~
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
拜託~

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Did you know that
they always leave one
of the windows to the temple
unlocked? You spy on the
priests inside. They're always
fighting! Isn't that bad?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
你知道嗎？
他們總是留一扇
通往神殿的窗戶不鎖。
你可以偷看裡面的牧師。
他們總是在打架！
這不好吧？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Oh well, they're adults,
so I dunno. Maybe they...
Mm. Well, I remember that
fighting is supposed to be bad...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
算了，他們是大人，
所以我不懂。也許他們...
嗯。反正我記得
打架是不好的事情...

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Now, I hope you
won't be mad at
me anymore...
If you're not,
then I'm gonna
be madder at you!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
現在，我希望你
不要再生我的氣了...
如果你不生氣，
那我就要更生氣啦！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
You're leaving?
Don't you want to
watch me play Rock,
Paper, Scissors?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
你要走了？
你不想看我玩
石頭剪刀布嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hey! I don't like
the way you're looking
at me. I don't like you
watching me like that!
Why don't you go away?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嘿！我不喜歡你
看我的眼神。
我不喜歡你
那樣盯著我看！
你幹嘛不滾開？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Gosh, I said, go away!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
天哪，我說了，
快滾開！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
If you're that bored,
why don't you peep through
the windows in the temple,
huh? Gosh! Some people!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
如果你那麼無聊，
幹嘛不去神殿的窗戶
往裡偷看呢？
真是的！有些人啊！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou notice a slightly
open window that
you can easily enter.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你注意到一扇
微微敞開的窗戶，
很容易就能進去。^000000

scripts.text: Stay
scripts.translation: 停牌

scripts.text: Enter Through Window
scripts.translation: 從窗戶進入

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou pull the window,
and it smoothly opens.
This is probably what
those mischevious hits
have been using to enter
unnoticed into this temple.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你拉開窗戶，
它很順滑地打開了。
這大概就是那些
調皮搗蛋的傢伙
用來神不知鬼不覺地
潛入這座神殿的通道。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decide that it's
wrong to sneak into
a place. But what if
you don't get caught?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你決定偷偷潛入
某個地方是不對的。
但如果你沒被抓到呢？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWould you like to
enter the temple
through this window?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你想通過這扇窗戶
進入神殿嗎？^000000

scripts.text: Enter
scripts.translation: 進入

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFUsing this window is
probably the only way
that you can enter.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF使用這扇窗戶
大概是你唯一
能進入的方法。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFThis window is open.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這扇窗戶是開著的。^000000

scripts.text: Stay
scripts.translation: 停牌

scripts.text: Exit Through Window
scripts.translation: 從窗戶離開

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's strangely
dark in here.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這裡莫名地
很昏暗。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou hear some
noise from the hallway
towards the chapel. It
sounds like there are
several other people here.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你聽到通往
禮拜堂的走廊裡
傳來一些聲響。
聽起來這裡
還有其他人。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou hear noises of some
commotion from the stairs.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你聽到樓梯那邊
傳來一陣騷動。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou hear something
fall from the stairs,
followed by noises that
sound like a scuffle.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你聽到有什麼東西
從樓梯上掉下來，
接著傳來像是
扭打的聲音。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's a spot on the
ground that's darker than
the rest of the floor...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF地面上有一塊
比周圍地板
更暗的地方...^000000

scripts.text: Investigate
scripts.translation: 調查

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's too dark to
really see the spot^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF太暗了，
看不清那塊地方^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt smells a little bit
like copper or iron. Blood
has probably been spilled here.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這裡有點
像銅或鐵的味道。
這裡大概
流了血。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decide that your
time would be better spent
investigating something else.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你決定把時間花在
調查別的事情上。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis dark spot on the
ground is really creepy,
no matter how many
times you look at it.^000000.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF地面上這塊黑斑真的很詭異，
無論看多少次都讓人毛骨悚然。^000000

scripts.text: Investigate Again
scripts.translation: 再次調查

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe blood on the ground
hasn't dried up yet, but
it's probably cold by now.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF地上的血還沒有幹，
但應該已經變涼了吧。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe amount of blood
on the ground is more
than can be contained in just
one person. You'd better get
out of here before it's too late.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF地上的血量遠超一個人的容量。
最好在情況惡化前離開這裡。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decide that your
time would be better spent
investigating something else.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你決定把時間花在
調查別的事情上。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis blood stain on the
ground is a pretty bad
sign. You might have to
escape this place before
whatever caused this much
bleeding does the same to you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF地上的血跡是個很壞的徵兆。
也許你得在造成這種大出血的東西
對你做同樣的事之前逃離此地。^000000

scripts.text:
[???]
Only the goddess exists.
scripts.translation:
[???]
唯有女神存在。

scripts.text:
[???]
Everyone must be
ready for her coming.
scripts.translation:
[???]
每個人都必須為她的降臨做好準備。

scripts.text:
[???]
Izlude, my hometown,
I have come to this
place to build.
scripts.translation:
[???]
依斯魯得島，我的家鄉，
我來到此地是為了建設它。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Th-that's Priestess
Panno's voice! But isn't
she just outside the door?
What exactly was she saying?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那...那是女祭司帕諾的聲音！
但她不是就在門外嗎？
她剛才到底在說什麼？

scripts.text: ^3355FFThe gate is closed.^000000
Push Gate
scripts.translation: 推門

scripts.text: Examine Gate
scripts.translation: 檢查大門

scripts.text: Kick Gate
scripts.translation: 踢門

scripts.text: Smash Gate with Weapon
scripts.translation: 用武器砸門

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou push the gate
with all of your might...
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你拼盡全力推門...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou push the gate
with all of your might...
But it won't even budge.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你拼盡全力推門...
但門紋絲不動。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's some strange
machinery installed on
the gate, and a slot where
it looks you you can insert
a card or permit. The lights
are on, so it must be working.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF門上安裝著某種奇怪的機械，
還有一個看起來可以插入卡片或許可證的插槽。
燈亮著，說明它正在執行。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou angrily kick the gate...
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你憤怒地踢門...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou angrily kick the gate...
But no matter how much rage
you put into your kick, the
gate refuses to open for you.
Oh, and your foot hurts too.^000000.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你憤怒地踢門...
但無論你在踢腿中注入多少怒氣，
門都拒絕為你開啟。
哦，還有，你的腳很痛。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait! That's not
a good idea. You can't
smash down the gate to
a holy place: heroes don't
specialize in desecration.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等等！這不是個好主意。
你不能砸開神聖之地的門：
英雄不擅長褻瀆神聖之物。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在攜帶的物品太多了。
請先使用卡普拉服務
將部分物品存入倉庫，
然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
For some reason, you look
familiar to me. Are you supposed
to be here? Otherwise, you should
leave this place if you don't have
the proper authorization.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
不知為何，我覺得你有些面熟。
你是應該在這裡的人嗎？
如果沒有得到正式授權，
你應該離開這個地方。

scripts.text: I'm here on Vincent's behalf
scripts.translation: 我是受文森特之託來的

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Vincent sent you? I see.
You must have been looking
for me. I am High Priest Zhed,
and I understand that you
have a package for me.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
是文森特派你來的？我明白了。
你一定是來找我的。
我是大祭司澤德，
我知道你有一件包裹要交給我。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Usually, Vincent doesn't
trust strangers to deliver
these packages, but perhaps
this was necessitated by some
strange circumstance. Anyway,
let's see what he sent me...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
通常，文森特不會信任陌生人
來送這些包裹，但也許
這是由某些特殊情況所迫。
總之，讓我們看看他寄了什麼...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Hm? What's this?
Vincent sent a note?
I suppose this must be
important. Give me just a
moment to read this, please...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
嗯？這是什麼？
文森特寄了一張紙條？
我想這一定很重要。
請給我一點時間讀一下...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
...............................
...Hrrrmm. Vincent. Now
I understand. So he was being
intentionally cold towards Jenny
and Phoebe so other people
wouldn't get suspicious...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
...............................
...嗯。文森特。
我現在明白了。
原來他故意對珍妮和菲比冷淡，
是為了不讓其他人起疑心...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Still, I don't think he
had to do that--it might
have been a little too
much. Well, I really
appreciate your help
in this matter, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
不過，我覺得他不必做到那種地步——
可能有點過頭了。
無論如何，非常感謝你
在這件事上對我的幫助，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
But tell me, did you only
help Vincent and risk your
life because you were being
paid? Were you only being
motivated by the money?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
但請告訴我，你幫助文森特
並冒著生命危險，
僅僅是因為拿了報酬嗎？
你只是被金錢驅動的嗎？

scripts.text: Actually... I was just curious.
scripts.translation: 其實...我只是出於好奇。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
You were doing this just to
satisfy your curiosity? Heh
heh, that's very interesting.
That's also the best attitude
for a brave adventurer. I like
that. May I have your name?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
你只是為了滿足好奇心才做這些？
呵呵，這很有趣。
這也是勇敢冒險者最好的態度。
我很喜歡。可以告訴我你的名字嗎？

scripts.text: Tell him your name.
scripts.translation: 告訴他你的名字。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
{0}...
Yes, that's a fine name.
It suits you well. I'll be sure
to remember that. Again, let
me thank you for risking your
life to retrive my belongings.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
{0}...
是的，這是個不錯的名字。
很適合你。我會記住的。
再次感謝你冒著生命危險
取回我的物品。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I shall be praying for
Freya to guide and protect
you in your travels. Peace
be with you, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
我會祈禱弗蕾雅女神
指引並保護你的旅途。
願平安與你同在，{0}。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Ah, {0}...
I appreciate that you've
managed to retrieve my
belongings for me. You are
a truly talented adventurer.
May Freya protect you...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
啊，{0}...
我很感激你成功
為我取回了物品。
你是一位真正有才華的冒險者。
願弗蕾雅保護你...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Ah, good, I was hoping you'd
show up here sooner or later.
I have a favor to ask of you
since I'm too busy to do it
myself, and I trust you more
than any other adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
啊，太好了，我本來希望你能早點來。
因為我太忙了，沒法親自去做，
所以想請你幫個忙，
而且我比信任其他任何冒險者都更信任你。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
However, before I give you
the details, you must know
that this favor must be kept
secret. In other words, once
I explain the task, you must
accept my request.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
不過，在我告訴你細節之前，
你必須知道這個請求必須保密。
換句話說，一旦我解釋了任務，
你就必須接受我的請求。

scripts.text: Let me think about it.
scripts.translation: 讓我考慮一下。

scripts.text: Yes, sure.
scripts.translation: 是的，準備好了。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I understand, but if you
change your mind, please
come back and let me know.
It's very hard for me to find
someone that I can really
rely on to do this for me...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
我理解，但如果你改變主意，
請回來告訴我。
對我來說，找到一個真正可以
信賴的人來做這件事非常困難...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Ah, I'm relieved to see
that you accept. Don't worry,
this task isn't complicated,
nor will it require much
in the way of sacrifice.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
啊，很高興你接受了。
別擔心，這個任務並不複雜，
也不需要太多的犧牲。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
As you may already know,
our country of Arunafeltz
worships the goddess Freya.
There's almost no separation
between politics, society,
and our religion, really.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
你可能已經知道了，
我們的國家阿魯納菲茲
崇拜女神弗蕾雅。
實際上，政治、社會和宗教之間
幾乎沒有界限。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Now, the leader of our
national religion, our pope,
is a direct servant of Freya
and delivers her messages
to us. As such, she must live
by very strict guidelines.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
我們國家宗教的領袖，也就是教皇，
是女神弗蕾雅的直接侍從，
負責將她的旨意傳達給我們。
因此，她必須遵循非常嚴格的準則。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Our pope is curious about
the outside world and wishes
to learn more about what lies
beyond Arunafeltz, but she
cannot come easily by this
sort of knowledge.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
我們的教皇對外界很好奇，
希望能瞭解更多阿魯納菲茲之外的世界，
但她很難輕易獲得這方面的知識。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Firstly, she cannot leave
Rachel, the place where the
spirit of goddess Freya dwells.
Secondly, all citizens and priests are forbidden to leave the city in
order to preserve our sanctity.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
首先，她不能離開拉赫，
那是女神弗蕾雅的精神居所。
其次，為了維護聖地的純潔性，
所有市民和牧師都被禁止離開城市。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
These are implicit rules that
normally aren't discussed openly,
but everyone follows them to
prevent from being stigmatized.
Frankly, I think it's somewhat shameful, but we're working on it.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
這些是心照不宣的規則，
通常不會公開討論，
但每個人都遵守它們，
以免受到指責。
說實話，我覺得這有點丟人，
但我們正在努力改變這一點。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Furthermore, our pope must
maintain her image of aloof
piety, so it'd be inappropriate of her to openly question outside
world affairs. Although, such
knowledge would benefit her...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
此外，我們的教皇必須保持
超然虔誠的形象，
所以她公開詢問外界事務是不合適的。
雖然，這些知識對她會有好處...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
That is why the high priests
decided to enlist a trustworthy
adventurer to inform our pope
about the outside world. Now
you understand why I've asked
you to keep all of this secret.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
這就是為什麼大祭司們決定
聘請一位值得信賴的冒險者，
向我們的教皇彙報外界的情況。
現在你明白我為什麼要求你
對這一切保密了吧。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
You won't need to divulge
outrageous secrets or anything
like that. I presume mundane
details would be enough to
please her. Just let her be
able to envision your homeland.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
你不需要透露什麼驚人的秘密
或類似的東西。
我想一些日常細節就足以
讓她滿意了。只要讓她能
想像出你的家鄉的樣子即可。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Personally, I think it would
be refreshing for our pope to
hear a few of your stories as
she is always worshipping
our goddess on the behalf of
everyone in our glorious city.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
就我個人而言，我覺得
讓我們的教皇聽你講幾個故事
會讓她耳目一新，
因為她一直代表著我們
輝煌城市裡的所有人崇拜女神。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Unfortunately, I cannot escort
you to the priestess, but I will
relate the means to which you
can gain an audience with her.
First, you will need a ^FF0000High
Priest's Recommendation^000000.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
不幸的是，我無法親自
護送你去見女祭司，
但我可以告訴你如何
獲得與她見面的機會。
首先，你需要一張^FF0000大祭司的推薦信^000000。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I will write that for you, so
there's no need to concern
yourself with that. Next, you
will need to gather ^FF000040 Glacial
Hearts^000000 as symbolic proof of
your strength and purity.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
我會為你寫好這張推薦信，
所以你不需要為此擔心。
接下來，你需要收集^FF000040個冰塊心臟^000000，
作為你力量和純潔的象徵性證明。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
While I finish writing this
recommendation, let me tell
you how to get to the pope's
office where you must go once
you gather 40 Glacial Hearts.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
在我寫完這張推薦信的同時，
讓我告訴你如何到達教皇執勤室，
當你收集齊40個冰塊心臟後，
你必須去那裡。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Head west from the chapel
in the center of the temple,
and then enter a door guarded
by two soldiers. Show them your
recommendation and Glacial Hearts, and they should grant you passage.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
從神廟中央的禮拜堂
向西走，然後進入一扇
由兩名士兵看守的門。
向他們出示你的推薦信和冰塊心臟，
他們應該會允許你通過。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Ah, here you are.
I've finished writing
your recommendation.
Well then, I guess I'll
see you after you've
completed this task.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
啊，你來了。
我已經寫好了你的推薦信。
那麼，我想在你
完成這個任務後再見。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received a High
Priest's recommendation.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你獲得了一張大祭司的推薦信。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Once you gather
^FF000040 Glacial Hearts^000000,
you can show them, along
with the recommendation I've
written for you, to the soldiers
guarding the pope's office.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
一旦你收集齊
^FF000040個冰塊心臟^000000，
你可以將它們連同我為你
寫好的推薦信一起，
出示給看守教皇執勤室計程車兵。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
When you're ready to go
to the pope's office, just
head west from the chapel
to the center of the temple:
this is where the entrance is.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
當你準備好前往教皇執勤室時，
只需從禮拜堂向西走到
神廟中央：
入口就在這裡。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Ah, thank you so much
for spending some time
with the pope for me.
I can tell that she really
enjoyed speaking to you.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
啊，非常感謝你
抽出時間陪我見教皇。
我能感覺到她真的很
享受與你的交談。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I am curious, though...
Our pope is unaccustomed
to speaking with outsiders,
so I assume that you have
your own questions after
your conversation with her...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
不過，我很好奇...
我們的教皇不習慣與外人交談，
所以我猜在與她交談之後，
你自己也有一些問題想問...

scripts.text: Well, she did mention some Holy Ground...
scripts.translation: 嗯，她確實提到了聖地...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
What...?!
She mentioned
the Holy Ground...?!
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
什麼...？！
她提到了聖地...？！

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
The Holy Ground is a place
where all humans, including
the pope, have been forbidden.
We used to allow people to
visit in the past, but...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
聖地是一個連教皇在內的
所有人類都被禁止進入的地方。
過去我們曾允許人們參觀，但是...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Only the gods can access
that place now. Listen, if
the other priests ask about
your conversation with the
pope, please do not make any
mention of the Holy Ground.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
現在只有神明才能進入那裡。
聽著，如果其他牧師問起
你和教皇的談話，
請不要提及聖地。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Please don't ask me
why, but believe me that
it's very important that
you feign ignorance of the
Holy Ground's existence!
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
請不要問我為什麼，
但相信我，
假裝不知道聖地的存在
非常重要！

scripts.text:
[????]
Excuse me, Zhed?
May I speak with you
for a moment? I need
to talk to you about
a private matter...
scripts.translation:
[????]
打擾一下，澤德？
可以佔用您一點時間嗎？
我有一件私事需要和您談談...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Er, yes, of course!
Excuse me for a moment...
While you're waiting for me,
why don't you relax in the
next room? Don't forget:
there is no Holy Ground.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
呃，是的，當然可以！
請稍等片刻...
在您等待我的時候，
不妨去隔壁房間休息一下？
別忘了：
沒有所謂的聖地。

scripts.text: Okay.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I'm sorry, but we're not
quite finished with our
discussion. Why don't you
wait and relax in the next room
over there in the meantime?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
抱歉，我們的談話還沒結束。
在此期間，
您不妨去那邊隔壁房間
等待並休息一下？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I apologize for making
you wait for so long: I had
some crucial matters to
discuss. Now, that look
on your face tells me that
you have a pressing question.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
讓您久等了，我很抱歉：
我有一些緊要的事情要討論。
現在，您臉上的表情告訴我，
您有一個迫切的問題。

scripts.text: Ask about Bekento
scripts.translation: 詢問關於貝肯托

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Bekento? Ah, you must
have been speaking to
High Priestess Niren.
She's the only one that
calls me that. You see, my
full name is Zhed Bekento.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
貝肯托？啊，您一定是
和大祭司 尼倫交談過了。
只有她那樣稱呼我。
您看，我的全名是澤德·貝肯托。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Speaking of which...
Did Niren ask you anything
or tell you something that
was out of the ordinary?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
說到這個...
尼倫有沒有問您什麼，
或者告訴您什麼
不尋常的事情？

scripts.text:
^3355FFAfter a little hesitation,
you tell High Priest Zhed
about your conversation
with High Priestess Niren.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF稍作猶豫後，
您向大祭司 澤德講述了
您與大祭司 尼倫的對話。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Hmm, I see.
Yes. That sounds
like something she'd do.
I'll explain it all later, but
right now, I need to rest.
I'm getting old, you know.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
嗯，我明白了。
是的。聽起來像是她會做的事。
我稍後向您解釋一切，
但現在，我需要休息。
畢竟我年紀大了，您知道的。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Ah, but before you go, let
me warn you not to ^FF0000go near
the Holy Ground^000000. I repeat,
stay away from the Holy Ground.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
啊，在您離開之前，
讓我警告您不要^FF0000靠近聖地^000000。
我再說一遍，
遠離聖地。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe Holy Ground...
Why is High Priest Zhed
so adamant about protecting
the Holy Ground? Regardless...
If you want to go there, then
just go there. Who'll stop you?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF聖地...
為什麼大祭司 澤德
如此堅決地要保護聖地？
無論如何...
如果您想去那裡，
那就去吧。誰會阻止您呢？^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Whatever you do, whatever
journeys you take, please
make sure that you stay
away from the Holy Ground!
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
無論您做什麼，
無論您踏上怎樣的旅程，
請務必遠離聖地！

scripts.text:
^3355FFNow, more than ever,
you feel compelled to
enter the Holy Ground.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF現在，比以往任何時候都更強烈地，
您感到必須進入聖地。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Oh, it's you.
Let me guess...
After everything I said,
you still went ahead and
visited the Holy Ground,
didn't you? Oh, well...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
哦，是你。
讓我猜猜...
在我說了那麼多之後，
你還是去了聖地，
對吧？唉，算了...

scripts.text: Did something happen?
scripts.translation: 發生什麼事了嗎？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Well, honestly, I've been
temporarily suspended from
work, but no need to worry.
It's not your fault. I've been
in conflict with the other High
Priests for a while, anyway.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
嗯，老實說，
我被暫時停職了，
但不用擔心。
這不是你的錯。
反正我和其他大祭司
已經衝突了一段時間了。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Please don't worry about it.
If not this, they would have
found some other way to attack
me. It would only be a matter
of time. They're exaggerating
your intrusion for their benefit.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
請不要擔心。
如果不是這件事，
他們也會找到其他辦法攻擊我。
這只是時間問題。
他們為了自己的利益，
誇大了你的闖入行為。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
All I want is for
Arunafeltz to be safe
and at peace. I hope this
land is not twisted by the
greedy humans. I hope all will
work according to Freya's will.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
我所希望的，
只是阿魯納菲茲能夠
安全且和平。
我希望這片土地
不會被貪婪的人類扭曲。
我希望一切
都能順應芙蕾雅神的旨意。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Ah, and please do not
blame Niren. She must have
her own reasons for her own
actions. She has changed
much but in the end, I think
that we are still friends.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
啊，還有，請不要
責怪尼倫。
她做出那樣的行為，
一定有她自己的理由。
雖然她改變了很多，
但歸根結底，我認為
我們依然是朋友。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
One last thing:
try not to let the
other priests catch you
doing anything forbidden.
It'd be a little embarassing
for me, you understand.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
最後還有一點：
儘量別讓其他祭司
發現你在做違禁的事。
那樣對我來說
會有點尷尬，你明白嗎。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Still, you were secretly
invited here, so I'm sure
that only a very few of them
would be able to recognize
you. In the end, you'll do
what you will, right?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
不過，既然你是被秘密
邀請來的，我相信
能認出你的人
應該寥寥無幾。
到頭來，你還是會
做你想做的事，對吧？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
...I think I know what
you saw in the Holy Ground.
I'm sure that you have much
to ask, but now isn't the time
to seek for answers. Please,
you must be patient.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
...我想我知道
你在聖地看到了什麼。
我相信你有很多
想要詢問的問題，
但現在還不是
尋求答案的時候。
請，
你要耐心一些。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Until the right time
comes, I want you not
to tell anyone else what
you saw in the Holy Ground.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
在合適的時間
到來之前，我希望你
不要告訴任何人
你在聖地看到的事情。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Well then, adventurer,
thank you for coming by.
I need to go lay down now,
so if you'll let me rest...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
那麼，冒險者，
感謝你的來訪。
我現在需要去躺下了，
如果你能讓我休息...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Ah, it's been a while,
hasn't it? You look well,
and I'm doing fine as you
can see. What can I do
for you today, {0}?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
啊，好久不見，
是嗎？你看起來氣色不錯，
我也很好，正如
你所見。今天有什麼
我可以幫你的嗎，{0}？

scripts.text: I just wanted to say hi.
scripts.translation: 只是想打個招呼

scripts.text: Ask About Veins Incident
scripts.translation: 詢問伯仁斯事件

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
As you well know, I'm only
a High Priest in title, and
lost much of my influence
amongst many of the other
priests for my views.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
正如你所知，我僅僅
是名義上的大祭司，
因為我的觀點，
我在其他祭司中
失去了很多影響力。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Still, I have faith that
justice and good will
prevail over the corruption
that plagues our priests,
so long as good people
are willing to act.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
儘管如此，我依然相信
正義和善良
終將戰勝困擾我們祭司的
腐敗，
只要善良的人們
願意採取行動。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Veins incident?
I haven't heard of
anything... Well, perhaps
if you'd elaborate, then
I'd understand a bit more.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
伯仁斯事件？
我好像沒聽說過...
嗯，也許如果你
能詳細說明一下，
我就能明白更多了。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou told High Priest
Zhed about the group of
smugglers arrested in Veins.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你告訴了大祭司 澤德
關於在伯仁斯被捕的
走私團伙的事。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Oh, I think I did hear
something about that earlier.
Let's see now... Ah, right.
Niren mentioned something
strange about them...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
哦，我想我確實
之前聽說過一些。
讓我想想...啊，對了。
尼倫提到過關於他們的
一些奇怪的事情...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
The smugglers were with
a high ranking official from
the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom,
which is why Niren was so
hesitant to take any action
against them for a while.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
那些走私犯與
盧恩·米德加茲王國的
一位高官有關，
這就是為什麼尼倫
在很長一段時間內
都猶豫著沒有對他們
採取任何行動。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I was too preoccupied with
other matters, and I didn't
think much of it at the time.
Why don't you speak to Niren?
I'm sure that she can tell you
more about what happened.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
我當時太忙於其他事務，
所以當時沒怎麼在意。
你不妨去問問尼倫？
我相信她能告訴你
更多關於當時發生的事。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
If you do decide to
visit Niren, please
send her my regards.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
如果你決定
去拜訪尼倫，請
代我向她問好。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Ah, it does my heart to
good to see you again.
Adventurers willing to work
so hard for the sake of world
peace like yourself are fairly
uncommon. I hope you know that.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
啊，再次見到你
真是令我欣慰。
像你這樣願意為了
世界和平而如此努力
的冒險者相當罕見。
我希望你知道這一點。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh...?
Please don't flatter
me like that! Saying
it like that is kind of
overdoing it, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...？
請不要這樣
奉承我！
這麼說有點
太過分了，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Not at all. In fact, I'm
sure that a place in
Valhalla has already
been secured for you
by the Valkyries. Now, how
may I help you, my friend?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
哪裡哪裡。事實上，我確信瓦爾基里們已經為你在英靈殿預留了位置。那麼，我的朋友，有什麼我可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: Mysterious Building in the Volcano
scripts.translation: 火山中的神秘建築

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, I was wondering
if you knew of anything about
this facility inside Thor
Volcano near Veins. There
might be something big
going on over there.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其實，我想知道你是否聽說過伯仁斯附近托爾火山裡的這個設施。那裡似乎正在發生一些大事。

scripts.text:
^3131FFYou told High Priest
Zhed about the shackled
child in Thor Volcano, and
how you found the building
hidden there. High Priest Zhed
seemed disturbed by your words.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3131FF你向大祭司 澤德講述了托爾火山中被鎖鏈束縛的孩子，以及你在那裡發現的隱藏建築。大祭司 澤德似乎被你的話驚擾了。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I see. I have my suspicions
about what is happening. Now,
you're aware that Arunafeltz
is governed by our church,
and that our entire nation
worships the goddess Freya.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
我明白了。我對那裡發生的事有所懷疑。你知道，阿魯納菲茲是由我們的教會治理的，我們整個國家都崇拜女神芙蕾雅。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
The priests that lead this
nation are split into two main
factions: I am considered part
of the moderate faction, which
usually butts heads with the
jingoistic hard-liner faction.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
領導這個國家的祭司分為兩大派系：我屬於溫和派，通常與好戰的強硬派發生衝突。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
These hard-liner priests
are more than willing to use
violent methods if they believe
it to be the will of Freya, and
are the ones that established
the military camp  at Thor Volcano.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
這些強硬派祭司如果認為這是芙蕾雅的旨意，就毫不猶豫地採取暴力手段，正是他們在托爾火山建立了軍事營地。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Of course, it's also
considered a geology camp
since they're always monitoring
that place for volcanic activity,
but for all intents and purposes,
they are training men to fight.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
當然，由於他們一直監測那裡的火山活動，這也被視為一個地質營地，但歸根結底，他們是在訓練士兵作戰。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
It scares me to think
about it, but I'm sure that
they have many military supplies
and machines of mass destruction
hidden over there in the camp.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
想到這些讓我感到害怕，但我確信他們在營地裡隱藏了大量的軍事物資和大規模殺傷性機器。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, what exactly do
they hope to accomplish
by fighting? How do they
intend to help the goddess
Freya by using violence?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，他們到底想通過戰鬥達成什麼目的？他們打算如何通過暴力來幫助女神芙蕾雅？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
All the priests agree that
reassembling Ymir's Heart will
revive Freya. As you know, the
pieces are scattered all over
the world. Some are possessed
by the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
所有祭司都同意，重新組裝尤彌爾之心將復活芙蕾雅。你知道，碎片散落在世界各地。有些被盧恩·米德加茲王國持有。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
In the interest of avoiding
conflict, the moderate faction
of priests decided to hire
scientists to reproduce Ymir's
Heart, resulting in an
imitation of that artifact.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
為了避免衝突，溫和派祭司決定聘請科學家來復制尤彌爾之心，從而製造出了該神器的仿製品。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
An imitation of Ymir's
Heart? I think I know of
a famous scientist from the
Schwarzwald Republic that
was working on that! Let's
see, his name was...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
尤彌爾之心的仿製品？我想我知道修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國有一位著名的科學家正在研究這個！讓我想想，他的名字是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Isn't the scientist's name...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那位科學家的名字是...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Oh, you've heard of him?
Yes, his name was Varmunt.
Unfortunately, he deliberately
destroyed the Imitation of
Ymir's Heart into pieces,
and then disappeared.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
哦，你聽說過他？是的，他的名字是瓦爾蒙特。不幸的是，他故意將尤彌爾之心的仿製品打碎，然後消失了。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
{0}?
No, that wasn't him.
The man that created the
imitation of Ymir's Heart
was named Varmunt.
He was truly a genius.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
{0}？
不，不是他。
製造尤彌爾之心仿製品的那位先生名叫瓦爾蒙特。
他確實是個天才。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I'm not sure what happened
to Varmunt. All I know was that
something serious happened
in the Schwarzwald Republic,
and that he disappeared in
the fiasco. It's strange...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
我不確定瓦爾蒙特後來怎麼樣了。我只知道修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國發生了一些嚴重的事情，而他在混亂中消失了。這很奇怪...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Although the working
Ymir's Heart imitation that
Varmunt had created was broken
into pieces, other scientists
managed to mostly reproduce
his work with unstable Ymir Hearts.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
雖然瓦爾蒙特製造的可用尤彌爾之心仿製品被打碎了，但其他科學家設法主要複製了他的工作，製造出了不穩定的尤彌爾之心。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Since our moderate faction,
was only able to provide
unstable Ymir Heart imitations,
the hard-liner faction quickly
gained more respectability than
us in the eyes of the people.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
由於我們的溫和派只能提供不穩定的尤彌爾之心仿製品，強硬派在民眾眼中迅速獲得了比我們要高的威望。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Despite our advanced weaponry
and armor, I'm afraid that our
country of Arunafeltz is not as
civilized and peaceful as I'd
like it to be, and the hard-liners
control our government now.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
儘管我們擁有先進的武器和盔甲，但我恐怕阿魯納菲茲並沒有我期望的那樣文明與和平。如今，強硬派已經控制了我們的政府。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Although the hard-liners
allowed us to continue
our research in faithfully
reproducing Ymir's Heart,
they've been developing their
military might unopposed.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
雖然強硬派允許我們繼續忠實地複製尤彌爾之心的研究，但他們一直在肆無忌憚地發展軍事實力。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
So basically, the moderates
are trying to recreate Ymir's
Heart at research centers
in the Holy Ground and the
Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
基本上，溫和派正在聖地和修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國的研究中心嘗試重現尤彌爾之心。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
The hard-liners are
training soldiers and
storing up military supplies
and weapons in their camp
in Thor Volcano. However,
I don't know any more details.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
強硬派正在訓練士兵，並在托爾火山營地囤積軍用物資和武器。不過，我不清楚更多細節。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This doesn't look good.
I mean, if they're gearing
up to take the Ymir Heart
Pieces by force, it'll be war
against the Schwalzvalt Republic
and the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這看起來不妙。
我是說，如果他們打算強行奪取尤彌爾心臟堆積物，那將是對修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國和盧恩·米德加茲王國的宣戰！

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Seeing as I'm part of the
moderate faction, as well as
recently demoted, I just don't
have access to much information
about the hard-liners. However,
there may still be hope yet...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
鑑於我是溫和派的一員，而且最近剛被降職，我很難獲取關於強硬派的太多情報。不過，也許還有希望...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
War would be bad for all
parties involved. That is
why I'd like to ask you to
sneak into the camp at
Thor Volcano for the sake of
protecting international peace.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
戰爭對所有相關方都是災難。因此，為了維護國際和平，我想請你潛入托爾火山的營地。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I really want to know
more about what they're
planning to do, but that
place is heavily guarded!
How am I going to sneak in?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我真的很想知道他們打算做什麼，但那個地方守衛森嚴！
我該怎麼潛進去呢？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
You're right.
We'll have to think
of a really good way
for you to infiltrate
that place. Hmmmm...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
你說得對。
我們必須想出一個好辦法讓你滲透進去。嗯...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
嗯...

scripts.text: How to Sneak into the Camp
scripts.translation: 如何潛入營地

scripts.text: The Moderates
scripts.translation: 溫和派

scripts.text: The Hard-Liners
scripts.translation: 強硬派

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I still don't have any
ideas for sneaking into
the camp at Thor Volcano.
Give me a little more time,
and hopefully we can figure
something out together.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
我還沒有想出潛入托爾火山營地的辦法。
請再給我一點時間，希望我們能一起想出對策。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
We priests of the moderate
faction are opposed to war,
so we've been trying to
develop imitations of Ymir's
Heart for a long time. We've
yet to succeed, unfortunately.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
我們溫和派的牧師反對戰爭，所以長期以來一直在嘗試開發尤彌爾之心的仿製品。不幸的是，我們尚未成功。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
The hard-liners actually
opposed our efforts, but
they've let us continue since
they think they can eventually
use imitation Ymir Hearts for
military purposes.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
強硬派其實反對我們的努力，但他們認為最終可以將尤彌爾之心的仿製品用於軍事目的，所以允許我們繼續。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
The Ymir Heart reproduction
project has been frustrating
the best minds in the world,
and some scientists have even
resorted to using forbidden
methods. It's a shame, really.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
尤彌爾之心複製專案讓世界上最聰明的人感到沮喪，一些科學家甚至 resort 到了使用禁忌的方法。這真是令人遺憾。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Varmunt actually succeeded
in recreating Ymir's Heart,
but then he destroyed it and
he disappeared. He did it to
prevent war, but we could
really use his help now.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
瓦爾蒙特實際上成功重現了尤彌爾之心，但他隨後將其摧毀並消失了。他這樣做是為了防止戰爭，但現在我們真的很需要他的幫助。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
The hard-liners are especially
fanatical in their devotion to
Freya, and will use any means
to further what they interpret
as her will. They're willing to
go to war for their beliefs.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
強硬派對芙蕾雅尤其狂熱，他們會不惜一切手段來推行他們解讀的神意。他們願意為信仰而戰。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
The fact that they've even
built a military camp in Thor
Volcano disturbs me greatly.
It's almost certain that they
intend to wage war against any
nation with a Ymir's Heart piece.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
他們甚至在托爾火山建立了軍事營地，這讓我深感不安。幾乎可以肯定，他們打算對任何擁有尤彌爾心臟堆積物的國家發動戰爭。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Who is in charge of that
camp at Thor's Volcano?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
托爾火山後勤基地的營地是由誰負責的？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
High Priest Vildt.
He's in charge of all
important buildings in
Arunafeltz. His room is at
the other side of the building,
but it's always heavily guarded.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
是大祭司 維爾德。
他負責阿魯納菲茲所有重要建築的管理。他的房間在建築的另一側，但那裡總是戒備森嚴。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Vildt is one of the
highest ranking members
of the hard-liner priest
faction. He rarely makes it
his business to see anybody
that he sees as beneath him.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
維爾德是強硬派神官派系中地位最高的人物之一。他很少會屈尊去見他認為地位低下的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Would you please
take a look at this
file, High Priest Zhed?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
大祭司 澤德，請您看一下這份檔案好嗎？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Of course.
Let's see, what's
in this File Folder?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
當然可以。
讓我看看，這個薄的檔案夾裡有什麼？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
This is a geological
report about Thor Volcano?
Ah, I see. They must have
someone regularly check
to see if it will erupt.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
這是一份關於托爾火山後勤基地的地質報告？
啊，我明白了。他們一定安排了專人定期監測火山是否會噴發。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Although it's fairly dangerous
to build a military camp there,
some weapon materials can
only be forged from the heat
coming from Thor's Volcano.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
雖然在那裡建立軍事營地相當危險，但有些武器材料只能利用托爾火山後勤基地的熱量來鍛造。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Yes, I think it's also
likely that there are special
weapon crafting metals and
materials that can only be
found on the volcano. That
makes perfect sense.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
是的，我認為那裡很可能還有特殊的武器鍛造金屬和材料，且只能在火山找到。這完全說得通。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Although the volcano is
dormant now, these reports
claim that the volcano is
either safe or ready to erupt
at any time. The data here
doesn't make any sense.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
雖然火山目前處於休眠狀態，但這些報告聲稱火山要麼安全，要麼隨時可能噴發。這裡的資料毫無邏輯可言。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Hm. This is just a hunch,
but seeing these discrepancies
in his reports, I really think this geologist has an agenda against
the camp at Thor Volcano.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
嗯。這只是我的直覺，但鑑於他報告中的這些矛盾之處，我真的很懷疑這位地質學家對托爾火山後勤基地的營地另有圖謀。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
You know, if that's true,
he might be able to help
you sneak into the camp.
Don't you think it's worth
checking out for now?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
你看，如果情況屬實，他或許能幫你潛入營地。
你覺得現在去查一下值得嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Well, you never know
until you ask. Besides,
I don't know if there's
any other way to sneak
into the Thor Volcano Camp...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
畢竟，不問問怎麼知道結果呢。況且，我也不清楚還有沒有其他辦法能潛入托爾火山後勤基地...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I hope you'll go and talk
to the geologist. He should
be in Veins, the desert city
south of Rachel. He's your
best chance of entering the Thor
Volcano camp without suspicion.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
我希望你能去和那位地質學家談談。他應該在拉赫南邊的沙漠城市伯仁斯。這是你不受懷疑地進入托爾火山後勤基地營地的最佳機會。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh...?
Where did I put
that File Folder?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦...？
我把那個薄的檔案夾放哪兒了？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I hope you'll go and talk
to the geologist. He should
be in Veins, the desert city
south of Rachel. He's your
best chance of entering the Thor
Volcano camp without suspicion.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
我希望你能去和那位地質學家談談。他應該在拉赫南邊的沙漠城市伯仁斯。這是你不受懷疑地進入托爾火山後勤基地營地的最佳機會。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I hope you'll go and talk
to the geologist. He should
be in Veins, the desert city
south of Rachel. He's your
best chance of entering the Thor
Volcano camp without suspicion.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
我希望你能去和那位地質學家談談。他應該在拉赫南邊的沙漠城市伯仁斯。這是你不受懷疑地進入托爾火山後勤基地營地的最佳機會。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Oh! You're back!
Was that geologist able
to help you sneak into
the Thor Volcano camp?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
哦！你回來了！
那位地質學家能幫你潛入托爾火山後勤基地的營地嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
More than that. We've
convinced the camp that the
volcano is going to explode,
so they're scrambling to
evacuate. They're really
panicking over there!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不僅如此。我們已經讓營地相信火山即將爆炸，所以他們正忙著疏散。那邊的人真的慌了神！

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Hahaha! That's great!
Even if they do figure
out that they've been
fooled, it will take them
some time to realize it
in all that confusion.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
哈哈哈！太好了！
即使他們最終發現被騙了，在那樣的混亂中，也需要一段時間才能反應過來。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Yes, it might not be the
perfect time to bring down
the hard-liner faction right
now, but the opportunity
should present itself soon.
Thank you for all your help.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
是的，現在可能不是打擊強硬派派系的完美時機，但機會很快就會出現的。感謝你的全力協助。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Please relax for a while,
and I'll take care of the rest.
When the time to strike comes,
I will be contacting you again.
Together, we can protect
peace between our nations.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
請好好休息一會兒，剩下的交給我處理。
當行動的時刻到來時，我會再次聯絡你。
我們一起，守護國家間的和平。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I'll be sure to contact
you again for your help
when the time is right.
I'm sure there are others
that may need you now...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
時機成熟時，我會再次聯絡你尋求幫助。
我相信現在肯定還有其他人需要你...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Welcome, adventurer.
I'm glad to see that you're
here. I think... I think an
opportunity has arisen in
which I could use your
expert assistance.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
歡迎，冒險者。
很高興見到你。我想...我想出現了一個機會，需要你的專業協助。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Though, I fear that I may be
making the wrong decision.
After all, I no longer have
much influence among the
other priests... I can't help
but think I'm in the wrong.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
不過，我恐怕自己可能做出了錯誤的決定。
畢竟，我在其他牧師中的影響力已經大不如前...我不禁懷疑自己是否走錯了路。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't lose heart,
High Priest Zhed.
I... I believe in you!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不要灰心，大祭司 澤德。
我...我相信你！

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I guess you're right.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
你說得對。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
As you well know, the
highest authority in
Arunafeltz is our Pope,
the reincarnation of
our goddess Freya.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
正如你所知，阿魯納菲茲的最高權威是我們的教皇，她是女神芙蕾雅轉世。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Unfortunately, she is too
young and innocent, and she
doesn't yet have the experience
to assert control, and stamp
out the in-fighting and
corruption among the priests.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
不幸的是，她還太年輕、太天真，缺乏足夠的經驗來掌控局面，並平息牧師們內部的爭鬥與腐敗。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
In these desperate times,
we will need someone to
provide strong and confident
leadership to the people
of Arunafeltz before all
is lost to war and violence.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
在這個危急時刻，我們需要有人為阿魯納菲茲的人民提供堅定而自信的領導力，以免一切在戰爭與暴力中毀滅。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
I know it may not be
right, but someone
must do something
before the other High
Priests ruin our nation.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
^333333*嘆息...*^000000
我知道這可能並不正確，但在其他大祭司毀掉我們的國家之前，必須有人採取行動。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Y-you're not thinking
of overthrowing the
pope are you? I-isn't
that a bit extreme?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你...你不會是想推翻教皇吧？這...這不是很極端嗎？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
What? No, no!
Don't jump to conclusions
like that! Don't misunderstand
me: I'm loyal to our pope.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
什麼？不，不！
不要那樣妄下結論！別誤會我：我對我們的教皇忠心耿耿。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I actually want to work
very closely with the pope,
in essense, rule together with
her by combining my experience
and her wisdom. It's ambitious,
but what else can I do?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
我其實想與教皇緊密合作，本質上是將我的經驗與她的智慧結合，共同治理。這很宏大，但我還能做什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
You remember how you
stopped the hard-liner
priests from carrying out
their plans for war in the
Thor Volcano camp? That will
only stop them temporarily.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
你還記得你如何阻止強硬派牧師在托爾火山後勤基地執行他們的戰爭計劃嗎？那隻能暫時阻止他們。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
They'll eventually prepare
to act out in violence again.
We need a permanent solution
to ensure that this sort of
thing doesn't happen again.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
他們最終還是會再次準備採取暴力行動。我們需要一個永久的解決方案，以確保這種事不再發生。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
We need to convince the
pope to finally act, and
give my policy of peace
her full support. Will
you help me to do this?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
我們需要說服教皇最終採取行動，並全力支援我的和平政策。你願意幫我做到這一點嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
Well... Asking for the
pope's support is the only
solution I've been able to
find. Do you have any ideas
for protecting peace here
in Arunafeltz?
scripts.translation: 嗯...尋求教皇的支援是我目前能找到的唯一解決辦法。對於如何守護阿魯納菲茲的和平，你有什麼想法嗎？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Well, I don't know.
It's a good idea, but
I fear that it will only
be effective in the short
term. Why don't we just
try what I've proposed first?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
嗯，我不知道。
這是個好主意，但我擔心它只能短期有效。我們何不先試試我提出的方案？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Hmm, now how can
we convince the pope to
support us? Even as Freya's
reincarnation... She's just
a young girl. She probably
knows nothing of politics.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
嗯，那我們該如何說服教皇支援我們呢？即使是芙蕾雅的轉世...她也只是個年輕女孩。她可能對政治一無所知。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
It'd probably be best to
tell her exactly what is
happening. The full truth.
In my heart, I know that
would be best.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
最好告訴她正在發生的一切。全部的真相。在我心裡，我知道那是最好的辦法。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
But... Maybe it would
be better if we sugar
coated it a little bit.
She might not be too
receptive to us if we
totally shock her.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
但是...也許我們最好稍微委婉一點。
如果我們直接告訴她全部真相，
她可能會受到太大沖擊，
從而對我們產生牴觸。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Hmm... What do you
think? Should we stick
with the truth, or do you
think it'd be better if we
exaggerate and... lie when
we feel it's necessary?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
嗯...你覺得呢？
我們是堅持說真話，
還是你覺得在必要時
誇大其詞...甚至撒謊會更好？

scripts.text: Truth
scripts.translation: 真話

scripts.text: Lies
scripts.translation: 謊言

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
That's what I think too.
Although I'm worried about
how the pope will react at
our message, I should have
faith. I should have faith.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
我也這麼認為。
雖然我很擔心教皇聽到我們的訊息後會作何反應，
但我應該保持信任。我應該保持信任。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I suppose that you may
have a point. It might not
be a good idea to totally
expose her to the ugly
truth. I'll try to be as
honest as I can...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
我想你也許有道理。
完全向她揭露醜陋的真相可能不是個好主意。
我會盡量保持誠實...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Well, there's no time
to waste. The two of us may
not be enough to convince
the pope to act for peace.
I already have someone in
mind that might help us.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
好了，沒時間浪費了。
我們兩個人可能不足以說服教皇為和平採取行動。
我已經想到一個可能幫上忙的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That sounds good.
Who is he?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
聽起來不錯。
他是誰？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
My old friend, High Priest
Niren. I'm not sure if she'll
help me after all that's
happened between us. She
may even think I deserve
to be excommunicated...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
我的老朋友，大祭司尼倫。
我不確定在發生那些事之後，
她是否還會幫我。
她甚至可能認為我理應被逐出教門...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Come on, it wouldn't
hurt to try! Besides,
Niren isn't a bad person.
Maybe she'll understand
the way you see things
if you explain them?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
來吧，試一試又不會有什麼壞處！
而且，尼倫並不是個壞人。
如果你解釋清楚，
也許她會理解你的看法？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
You're right, of course.
I'm just grasping at straws
here, but she and I both used
to believe that peace was
possible. I don't know why
she joined the hard-liners...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
你說得對，當然。
我只是在孤注一擲，
但她和我過去都相信和平是可能的。
我不知道她為什麼加入了強硬派...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
{0}...
Would you please talk to
her, and just see how she's
doing? It might not be a good
time to mention our plan
right away, though...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
{0}...
請你去和她談談，
看看她最近怎麼樣？
不過，也許現在還不是
立刻提及我們計劃的好時機...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
If you think that you
have a chance of convincing
her, then feel free and offer
my proposal. Her office is
located across from here,
but she's always very busy...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
如果你覺得你有機會說服她，
那就儘管提出我的建議吧。
她的辦公室就在對面，
但她總是很忙...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
There's actually
a good chance that
she is away somewhere
on business. She is highly
loved by the people, you know.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
實際上，她很可能
正外出處理公務。
你知道的，她很受民眾愛戴。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Please speak to Niren,
and she if she'd be willing
to help us convince the pope
to enforce peace in our nation.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
請去和尼倫對話，
問問她是否願意幫助我們
說服教皇在我國推行和平。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Welcome back.
So did you get a chance
to speak to Niren? How did
she respond to my proposal?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
歡迎回來。
你有機會和尼倫談談嗎？
她對我的建議有什麼反應？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou explain Niren's reasons
for her disappointment in
the Moderate priest faction,
and tell Zhed that she intends
to carry out the plans for war.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你向澤德解釋了尼倫對溫和派牧師派系感到失望的原因，並告訴她打算執行戰爭計劃。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Hmm... This explains why
she and some other high
priests started being absent
from their offices. Many of
them were invited over to
the Schwarzwald Republic...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
嗯...這就解釋了為什麼她和其他一些大祭司
開始缺席他們的辦公室。
他們中的許多人被邀請到了修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Regardless, I know for
a fact that war is never
a solution. It only brings
death and destruction.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
無論如何，我確信戰爭從來不是解決方案。
它只會帶來死亡和毀滅。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Give me a moment.
I'm going to write
a letter that I want
you to give to Niren.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
請給我一點時間。
我要寫一封信，
希望你能把它交給尼倫。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Please bring this letter
to Niren. I hope what
I have to say will help
her understand how I feel
about these plans for war.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
請把這封信帶給尼倫。
我希望我說的話能讓她理解
我對這些戰爭計劃的感受。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received a letter for
Niren from High Priest Zhed.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你收到了大祭司 澤德給尼倫的信件。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Please deliver my
letter to Niren as
soon as you can.
I really appreciate
you helping me on this.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
請儘快把我的信交給尼倫。
非常感謝你在這件事上幫我的忙。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Great news! Niren just
sent me a reply: I can't
believe that she's willing
to help me! Would you please
give her any help that she
may need from now on?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
好訊息！尼倫剛剛給我回了信：
我簡直不敢相信她願意幫我！
從現在起，如果她需要任何幫助，
請你務必協助她，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Ah, I've been
waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
啊，我一直在等你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
High Priest Zhed,
everything's ready!
High Priest Niren managed
to send away all of those
followers that were near the
pope. You won't be interrupted.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
大祭司 澤德，
一切準備就緒！
大祭司 尼倫已經設法
讓教皇身邊的所有信徒都離開了。
您不會被打擾的。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I hope we can get the pope
to understand the situation
of our nation. I only...
Oh, Freya help us...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
我希望能讓教皇理解我們國家的處境。
只是...
哦，芙蕾雅女神保佑我們...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Alright, I'm ready.
Let's receive an
audience with the
pope, shall we?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
好了，我準備好了。
我們去見教皇吧，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I'm a little nervous
about talking so brazenly
to the pope, but I'm
ready to go meet her.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
我要如此直率地和教皇交談，
我有點緊張，
但我已經準備好去見她了。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I believe that Niren
has something important
to tell you. Why don't
you speak to her before
coming back to me?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
我相信尼倫有重要的事情要告訴你。
在你回來找我之前，
為什麼不先和她談談呢？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I'm glad that everything
turned out great. Your
help was truly a blessing.
Although Schwarzwald will
continue their plans without
us, we've slowed them down.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
很高興一切順利。
你的幫助真是莫大的恩賜。
雖然修瓦魯茲巴魯德將繼續他們的計劃，
但我們已經拖延了他們的腳步。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Yes, without our support,
Schwarzwald won't have
any excuse to continue
their dangerous research
for a little while, at least.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
是的，沒有我們的支援，
修瓦魯茲巴魯德至少暫時
沒有藉口繼續他們危險的研究了。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Thor Volcano Camp
should close down soon,
now that we no longer
have any use for it.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
既然我們不再需要使用它，
托爾火山後勤基地應該很快就會關閉了。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I also underestimated our
pope. She is more dignified,
willed that I believed.
I owe her my apologies.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
我也低估了我們的教皇。
她比我以為的更有尊嚴，
意志更堅定。
我欠她一個道歉。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
We won't give up on
reviving our goddess Freya,
but we will retrieve Ymir's
Heart through diplomacy
rather than violence.
It won't be easy...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
我們不會放棄復活女神芙蕾雅，
但我們將通過外交手段而非暴力
來取回尤彌爾之心。
這不會容易...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
You've been instrumental
in returning peace here in
Arunafeltz. I've even been
reinstated, and will be very
busy from now on, working
closely with the pope...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
你為阿魯納菲茲恢復和平做出了巨大貢獻。
我也被恢復了職位，
從現在起會很忙，
需要與教皇密切合作...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
I know that the life of
adventuring beckons you.
I know she'd like to see
you before you leave, but
she's sleeping deeply after
that exhausting speech...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
我知道冒險的生活在召喚著你。
我知道她想在你要離開前見你，
但在那場令人精疲力竭的演講後，
她正在熟睡...

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
On behalf of our pope
and all the citizens of
Arunafeltz, I'd like to
thank you for your heroism.
Your place in Valhalla is
already assured, I'm sure.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
代表我們的教皇和阿魯納菲茲的所有市民，
我想感謝你的英勇行為。
我相信，你在英靈殿的位置已經確定了。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
May Freya bless you
on all your journeys,
my good friend.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
願芙蕾雅保佑你

the desert into green fields.
