而不是一個國家的莊嚴宗教領袖。^000000

scripts.text:
[Pope]
...Wow, sometimes, I really
wish I could live like you.
You'd think being pope would
be great, but they make me work
all the time. And there are all
sorts of things I can't do.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
...哇，有時候，我真的
希望能像你一樣生活。
你以為當教皇會很棒，
但他們讓我一直工作。
而且有很多事情我不能做。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
You know what's weird?
I think I'm the head of this
religion, but there's a sacred
place that even I'm not allowed
to visit. Isn't that so weird?
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
你知道什麼很奇怪嗎？
我想我是這個宗教的領袖，
但有一個神聖的地方，
連我都不被允許進入。
這不是很奇怪嗎？

scripts.text: R-really...?

[Pope]
...Yeah. I don't know
much about, and I'm not
really supposed to talk
about it. We just call this
place the ''Holy Ground...''
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
...是的。我不太瞭解，
而且我也不應該談論它。
我們只是把這個地方
稱為“聖地...”

scripts.text: Holy Ground?
scripts.translation: 聖地？

scripts.text:
[Pope]
I'm sorry... I want
to tell you more, but...
That's all I know. I wonder...
I wonder what they could
be hiding over there...
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
對不起...我想
告訴你更多，但是...
我只知道這些。我想知道...
我想知道他們在那裡
可能隱藏著什麼...

scripts.text:
[Priest]
I'm sorry to interrupt
your Excellency, but it's
time to officiate services.
Pardon me.
scripts.translation:
[牧師]
很抱歉打擾您，陛下，
現在是主持儀式的時間了。
請原諒。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Already?! Hmpf...
Oh, before I forget,
I needed to tell you that
High Priest Zhed wanted
to talk to you, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
已經這麼晚了嗎？哼...
啊，差點忘了，
大祭司 澤德想見你，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
I really want to thank
you for coming to speak
to me. I had a great time
learning. Now I have to
go officiate services, so...
This is goodbye for now...
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
真的很感謝你願意來和我對話。
和你一起學習讓我很開心。
現在我要去主持儀式了，所以...
暫時就到這裡吧...

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Oh, that's right...
Zhed... Er, High Priest
Zhed wanted to speak to you!
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
哦，對了...
澤德...呃，大祭司 澤德想和你對話！

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Oh, hello! It's you again!
Have you come to tell me
interesting stories about
the outside world again?
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
哦，你好！又是你啊！
你是來給我講外面世界
的有趣故事了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Mm. That sounds pretty
strange to me. Well, it's
good to hear it from you.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
嗯。聽起來挺奇怪的。
不過，能聽到你這麼說，
我也很高興。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(^333333I can't just leave
now. I should try to see
if I can learn anything
useful from the pope...^000000)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(^333333現在不能就這樣離開。
我應該試著從教皇那裡
學到一些有用的東西...^000000)

scripts.text: Aren't you lonely?
scripts.translation: 你不覺得孤獨嗎？

scripts.text: Do you ever take a break?
scripts.translation: 你會休息嗎？

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Well, there are always
some priests with me all
the time. Some of them
even watch me when I sleep.
I don't think I have time
to feel lonely, actually.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
嗯，總是有牧師陪在我身邊。
有些甚至在我睡覺時也在看著我。
我想，我其實沒有時間去感到孤獨。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Thank you for asking.
Sometimes... Sometimes
I wonder if I have a real
family. I don't even know
who'd they be or if they
exist. I don't know...
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
謝謝你的關心。
有時候...有時候我會想，
我是否有真正的家人。
我甚至不知道他們是誰，
或者他們是否存在。我不知道...

scripts.text:
[Pope]
I... I'm sorry.
I guess you didn't
expect to hear something
like that. ^666666*Sigh*^000000 I'm feeling
pretty exhausted. I better...
I better get some rest...
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
我...對不起。
我想你沒想到會聽到這樣的話吧。^666666*嘆氣*^000000 我覺得很疲憊。我最好...
我最好去休息一下...

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Well, even if I wanted
to, I can't just go out
and play. As pope... Well...
Everyone and everything
sort of needs my attention.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
嗯，即使我想，
我也不能隨便出去玩耍。
作為教皇...嗯...
每個人和每件事都需要我的關注。

scripts.text:
[Follower]
The pope said that she's
exhausted. Please come
back when she's feeling
better, and she will have
an audience with you.
scripts.translation:
[信徒]
教皇說她很疲憊。
請等她感覺好些時再來，
她會接見你的。

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt sounds like they're
still talking. It'd be
best to patient and wait
just a little while longer.
Still... It's awfully boring.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF聽起來他們還在談話。
最好耐心一點，再等一會兒。
不過...這也太無聊了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFA little eavesdropping
never hurt anyone. Maybe
you can hear them a little
better if you listen from
the left side of the wall.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF偷聽一下也沒壞處。
也許從牆的左邊聽，
能聽得更清楚一點。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAt this distance you
can cleartly hear the
voices from the other
side of the wall...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在這個距離，
你能清楚地聽到牆另一邊的眾聲...^000000

scripts.text:
[????]
...Was it really
necessary to involve
an outsider in this
situation? Answer me!
scripts.translation:
[????]
...有必要讓一個外人
捲入這件事嗎？回答我！

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Is this about the
accident? You know that
I've disagreed with the
actions that have led to
the mana leakage.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
這是關於那次事故嗎？
你知道，我一直反對
導致瑪娜洩漏的那些行動。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Even though I thought
it was a reckless decision,
I've closed the shrine and
did my best to cover up this
unfortunate accident.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
儘管我認為那是一個魯莽的決定，
但我還是關閉了神龕，
並盡力掩蓋了這場不幸的事故。

scripts.text:
[????]
I'm not blaming you. In
fact, I'll admit it: that was
our mistake. We caused
the monster infestation by
letting the mana leak.
scripts.translation:
[????]
我沒有責怪你。
事實上，我承認：那是我們的錯誤。
我們讓瑪娜洩漏，導致了魔物氾濫。

scripts.text:
[????]
But that's not related
to what I'm asking you!
Do you really think it's
alright to allow an outsider
to speak to our pope during
such a tumultuous time?!
scripts.translation:
[????]
但這與我問你的無關！
你真的認為在這種動盪時期，
允許一個外人
與我們的教皇對話是合適的嗎？

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Why not? I thought it'd
bring her great comfort.
She is very confused as to
why the Holy Ground has been
closed, and she cannot know
what is happening there.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
為什麼不呢？我以為這會讓她感到寬慰。
她對聖地為何關閉感到非常困惑，
而且她無法得知那裡正在發生什麼。

scripts.text:
[High Priest Zhed]
Again... I strongly
disagree with what is
secretly going on over
there. I know that I can't
officially oppose this
course of action, but...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 澤德]
再說一次...我強烈反對
那邊秘密進行的事情。我知道我
無法正式反對這一行動方針，但是...

scripts.text:
[????]
There's nothing to worry
about! It'll all be over before
you know it. Besides, it's
too late to turn back now,
so I warn you: don't you
dare do anything foolish.
scripts.translation:
[????]
沒什麼好擔心的！
一切很快就會結束。況且，
現在想回頭也來不及了，
所以我警告你：千萬別做傻事。

scripts.text:
^3355FFSomeone's coming!
You'd better step away
from the wall and feign
ignorance as best you can!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF有人來了！
你最好離開牆邊，
儘量裝作什麼都不知道！^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Oh! You must be the one
High Priest Be- er, Zhed,
told me about. It's very nice
to meet you. High Priestess
Niren, at your service.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
哦！你一定是大祭司貝...呃，澤德
跟我提到的那個人。很高興見到你。
我是大祭司尼倫，請多指教。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I hear that you had the
privilege of speaking with
our pope, and that she had
a wonderful time. What did
you think of her, hm?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
我聽說你有幸與我們的教皇對話，
而且她過得很愉快。你覺得她怎麼樣，嗯？

scripts.text: She's different than what I expected...
scripts.translation: 她和我想像的不太一樣...

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Ah, I know what you mean...
Usually, most outsiders tell
me that they expect our pope
to be a wizened old man.
But that's not the case
here in Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
啊，我明白你的意思...
通常，大多數外人都告訴我，
他們以為我們的教皇是一位白髮蒼蒼的老人。
但在阿魯納菲茲，情況並非如此。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Usually, our pope is chosen
by her resemblance to our
goddess Freya. She must
have silvery blond hair, snowy
skin, and divinely colored
eyes. You saw, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
通常，我們的教皇是根據她與女神芙蕾雅
的相似程度選出的。她必須擁有銀金色的頭髮、
雪白的皮膚和神聖顏色的眼睛。你看到了，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I'm curious: what kinds
of things did you and the
pope talk about? As you know,
we priests are forbidden from
leaving Arunafeltz, so...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
我很好奇：你和教皇
聊了些什麼？你知道的，
我們牧師被禁止離開阿魯納菲茲，所以...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou relate the details of
your talk with the pope, but
you make sure not to mention
anything about the Holy Ground
as High Priest Zhed had asked.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你講述了與教皇對話的細節，
但遵照大祭司澤德的囑咐，
你沒有提及任何關於聖地的事情。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Ah, that's fairly
interesting, your land.
Tell me, how did you come
to know Bekento, er, I mean,
High Priest Zhed?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
啊，你的家鄉聽起來挺有趣的。
告訴我，你是怎麼認識貝克托，呃，我是說，
大祭司澤德的？

scripts.text: Explain how You Met High Priest Zhed
scripts.translation: 解釋你是如何認識大祭司澤德的

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
.........................
That's all? Hm? That's
pretty funny. ^333333*Sigh*^000000 I believe
he trusts people too much...
But that's only my opinion.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
.........................
就這些？嗯？真有趣。^333333*嘆氣*^000000 我相信
他太容易相信別人了...
但這只是我個人的看法。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
If you don't mind...
I want to give you a bit of
advice. Don't get too close
to High Priest Zhed. If you
do, you might end up getting
yourself in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
如果你不介意的話...
我想給你一點建議。不要與大祭司澤德
走得太近。如果你這樣做，
可能會給自己惹上麻煩。

scripts.text:
^3355FFHigh Priestess Niren left
as soon as she said those words.
What could she possibly mean?
For now, you may as well
talk to High Priest Zhed.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF大祭司尼倫說完這些話就離開了。
她到底是什麼意思？
眼下，你不妨去和大祭司澤德談談。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a small
shining object laid
on the floor.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現地板上放著一個
閃閃發光的小物件。^000000

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text: Pick It Up
scripts.translation: 撿起來

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decided to ignore
the small shining object,
no matter how important it
may be to you in the future.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你決定無視那個閃閃發光的小物件，
儘管它未來對你可能至關重要。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFUpon picking up the
object, you are able to
identify it as a small key.
Perhaps you can use it to
open some kind of lock.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF撿起那個物件後，
你認出它是一把小鑰匙。
也許你可以用它開啟某種鎖。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis must be the
entrance to the Holy
Ground. However, the
door in your way is locked.^000000.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這裡應該是聖地的入口。
然而，擋在你面前的門被鎖住了。^000000

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text: Use Small Key
scripts.translation: 使用小鑰匙

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou insert the Small
Key that you found in
High Priest Zhed's room,
and find that it is able
to unlock this door.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你插入了在大祭司澤德房間裡找到的那把小鑰匙，
發現它正好能開啟這扇門。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFThe door is locked.^000000

^3355FFThis large area looks
like it was artificially build
for some reason-- it doesn't
seem like an area naturally
infested by monsters.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這片廣闊的區域看起來像是為了某種目的而人工建造的——
這裡似乎並不是魔物自然滋生的地方。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFPerhaps if you explore
this place, you'll be able
to find something interesting.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF也許如果你探索一下這個地方，
就能找到一些有趣的東西。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's something here
beneath the water. This
may warrant a closer look.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF水底下有什麼東西。
也許值得仔細看看。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFNo wonder this object
in the water seems so
familiar: it's a Ymir's
Heart Piece! In fact, there's
dozens of them just lying here.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF難怪水中的這個物件看起來如此熟悉：
它是尤彌爾之心碎片！事實上，這裡散落著幾十塊。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWhy would so many of these
powerful artifacts be here
in the Holy Ground? Perhaps
this is the secret that the
priests are trying to keep.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF為什麼會有這麼多強大的神器出現在聖地？
也許這就是祭司們試圖保守的秘密。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
How dare you intrude
the Holy Ground! Identify
yourself! I'll have you tried!
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
你竟敢闖入聖地！
報上你的名號！我要審判你！

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
O-oh! It's you, the
adventurer recommended
by Bekento. Hm. I apologize
for snapping at you like
that. Didn't you know that
no one's allowed here?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
哦！原來是你，
貝克托推薦的冒險者。嗯。
抱歉剛才對你那麼兇。
你不知道這裡禁止任何人進入嗎？

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Hmm. Well, you Rune-Midgarts
adventurers are famous for your
skills and abilities, but this
was not expected. I mean, we
made sure this place was
absolutely secure.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
嗯。好吧，盧恩·米德加茲的冒險者
以技藝高超而聞名，但這也出乎意料。
畢竟，我們確保這裡絕對安全。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
What's done is done...
I warned Bekento that he
might cause trouble for you,
but it seems that you've
caused trouble for him.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
木已成舟...
我警告過貝克托，他可能會給你惹麻煩，
但看來是你給他惹了麻煩。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Understand this:
most intruders are
severely punished, but
because of my friendship
with Bekento, I'm letting
you off easy. Remember that.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
聽好了：
大多數闖入者都會受到嚴厲懲罰，
但看在我和貝克托的交情上，
我就放過你一次。記住這一點。

scripts.text:
^3355FFNiren began to chant
in a low voice, and your
eyelids grow heavier as you
grow drowsier and sleepier...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF尼倫開始低聲吟唱，
你的眼皮越來越沉重，
你變得越來越睏倦，最終陷入了沉睡...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou feel a slight headache
after you recollect your senses.
Somehow, you're been brought
back to Rachel Town. How long
have you been unconscious?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF當你恢復意識時，感到一陣輕微的頭痛。
不知怎的，你被帶回了拉赫城鎮。
你昏迷了多久？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt would be best to
ask High Priest Zhed
about what had happened.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF最好去問問大祭司澤德
到底發生了什麼。^000000

scripts.text:
[Arunafeltz Follower]
Excuse me, but
are you {0}?
scripts.translation:
[阿魯納菲茲信徒]
打擾一下，
你是{0}嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Arunafeltz Follower]
High Priest Zhed
would like to see
you right away, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯納菲茲信徒]
大祭司澤德
想立刻見你，{0}。

scripts.text: May ask why?
scripts.translation: 請問為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Arunafeltz Follower]
Well, I actually have no
idea. I'm only supposed to
inform you that he's looking
for you. Please visit High
Priest Zhed in the second
right room of the temple.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯納菲茲信徒]
其實我也不太清楚。
我只是奉命通知您，
大祭司澤德正在找您。
請去神殿右側第二間房間拜訪他。

scripts.text:
[Arunafeltz Follower]
May Freya bless you
on your journeys...
scripts.translation:
[阿魯納菲茲信徒]
願芙蕾雅保佑您的旅途...
